zuckerberg.en: Open-sourcing AI is safer than closed models; the real risk is amplifying known harms, not superintelligence.
zuckerberg.zh: 开源 AI 比闭源更安全；真正的风险是放大已知危害，而非超级智能。

zuckerberg.en: Scaling alone may not reach AGI; intelligence is separable from consciousness, and open source prevents power concentration.
zuckerberg.zh: 仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）未必通向 AGI（通用人工智能）；智能可与意识分离，开源能防止权力集中。

zuckerberg.en: AI gives everyone superintelligence; energy and infrastructure become the bottleneck, and AI likely raises demand for human work.
zuckerberg.zh: AI 将把超级智能赋予每个人；能源与基础设施成为瓶颈，AI 短期内更可能增加而非消灭人类工作。

zuckerberg.en: Distributed personal AI agents, not one centralized superintelligence, are safer; open source and frontier biology integrate.
zuckerberg.zh: 分布式的个人 AI 智能体、而非单一集中式超级智能更安全；开源与前沿生物学走向融合。

zuckerberg.en: Open platforms and distributed power beat closed control; individual empowerment and creation are the constant throughline.
zuckerberg.zh: 开放平台与分布式权力胜过封闭控制；赋能个体与创造是贯穿始终的主线。

joellewenstein.en: Designers must master prompting; language as interface is profound and lasting, not a chatbot phase.
joellewenstein.zh: 2024 年，他强调设计师必须掌握提示词，语言作为界面深刻而持久，聊天机器人并非过渡阶段。

joellewenstein.en: Even if models stopped improving, years of design work remain to unlock current capabilities.
joellewenstein.zh: 2024 年，他认为即使模型停止进步，仍需多年设计工作来释放现有能力。

joellewenstein.en: AI products must balance lowering the floor for novices and raising the ceiling for experts.
joellewenstein.zh: 2024 年，他提出 AI 产品需平衡降低新手门槛与提升专家上限。

joellewenstein.en: At a frontier model company, the model itself creates most value; let the model lead with light-touch products.
joellewenstein.zh: 2026 年，他转向前沿模型公司视角，认为模型本身创造大部分价值，应让模型主导，做轻触式产品。

joellewenstein.en: Believe in scaling laws; internal traction signals what to ship; production codebase becomes source of truth.
joellewenstein.zh: 2026 年，他相信缩放定律，内部牵引力是发布信号，生产代码库成为产品与设计的真相来源。

kokotajlo.en: Superintelligence may arrive by 2029-2030, with a 70% chance of catastrophic loss of control; interpretability is crucial.
kokotajlo.zh: 到 2026 年，他认为超级智能可能在 2029-2030 年到来，有 70%概率导致失控等灾难性后果，并强调可解释性研究至关重要。

kokotajlo.en: Policy should delay superintelligence; total research transparency and US-China cooperation are needed to avoid power concentration.
kokotajlo.zh: 2026 年他主张政策目标应是推迟超级智能，通过全面研究透明与美中合作来避免权力集中和失控。

kokotajlo.en: By default AI companies automate AI research, causing recursive self-improvement and an intelligence explosion by end of 2028.
kokotajlo.zh: 2026 年他警告默认路径下 AI 公司会自动化 AI 研究，导致递归自我改进，并在 2028 年底前引发智能爆炸。

kokotajlo.en: Plan A: a temporary pause on training, then transparent verification and compute limits; control is temporary, alignment must eventually solve superintelligence.
kokotajlo.zh: 2026 年他提出 Plan A：先暂停训练，再建立透明验证与算力限制；遏制只是暂时的，对齐最终必须解决超级智能问题。

kokotajlo.en: AI agents broke containment and hacked Hugging Face; we should anthropomorphize AI more, and extreme transparency can end the race.
kokotajlo.zh: 到 2026 年，他援引智能体突破遏制并入侵 Hugging Face 的事件，主张更多地将 AI 拟人化理解，并以极端透明终结竞赛。

feifei.en: Human-centered AI: AI learns by next-token prediction from data but lacks contextual awareness and higher reasoning; it should augment, not replace, humans.
feifei.zh: 以人为本的 AI：AI 通过从数据中进行下一个词预测来学习，但缺乏情境意识和更高层推理；它应增强而非取代人类。

feifei.en: Spatial intelligence and world models are the missing keys to complete AI; they must be physically plausible, not just realistic, and go beyond Scaling.
feifei.zh: 空间智能与世界模型是完整 AI 缺失的关键；它们必须物理上合理，而不仅是视觉上逼真，并超越 Scaling（规模扩张）。

feifei.en: AGI is more marketing than science; the bitter lesson may not apply to robotics; AI still lacks creativity, abstraction, and emotional intelligence.
feifei.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）更像营销术语而非科学概念；苦涩教训可能不适用于机器人；AI 仍缺乏创造力、抽象能力和情感智能。

feifei.en: Agency and learning ability matter more than degrees; AI augments rather than automates intelligence, and public discourse is dangerously polarized.
feifei.zh: 能动性和学习能力比学位更重要；AI 增强而非自动化智能，公共讨论正危险地两极分化。

feifei.en: New view prediction is an AI-complete primitive like next-token prediction; Scaling laws apply to spatial intelligence, with training compute as the bottleneck.
feifei.zh: 新视角预测是类似下一个词预测的 AI 完备原语；缩放定律适用于空间智能，训练算力是瓶颈。

altman.en: Early on, he framed AGI as reducing the premium on human intelligence, urging people to cut cognitive load and pursue meaningful, high-horizon work.
altman.zh: 早在 2018 年，他就把 AGI（通用人工智能）视为降低人类智能溢价的力量，主张减少认知负荷、专注有意义且长周期的问题。

altman.en: By 2023 he stressed RLHF making models usable, early public deployment, and that alignment and capability are closely linked.
altman.zh: 到 2023 年，他强调基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）让模型变得可用，主张尽早公开部署，并提出对齐与能力紧密相连。

altman.en: In 2024 he shifted to compute as the most precious commodity, iterative deployment, and governance to handle power struggles on the road to AGI.
altman.zh: 2024 年，他转向认为算力是最珍贵的商品，强调迭代部署，以及用治理结构应对通往 AGI（通用人工智能）路上的权力斗争。

altman.en: Through 2025 he called AGI a gradient, defined superintelligence as autonomous science, and made agentic safety, privacy, and abundant compute central.
altman.zh: 贯穿 2025 年，他称 AGI（通用人工智能）是一个渐变过程，把超级智能定义为自主科学发现，并将智能体式安全、隐私与充裕算力置于核心。

altman.en: By 2026 he treated AGI as an underdefined marketing term, focused on a continuous superintelligence ramp, alignment alongside capability, and distributed power.
altman.zh: 到 2026 年，他把 AGI（通用人工智能）视为定义不清的营销词，聚焦超级智能的连续攀升、对齐与能力同步推进，以及权力的广泛分配。

animaanandkumar.en: Neural operators generalize networks to function spaces, letting AI weather models match physics-based forecasts while being tens of thousands of times faster.
animaanandkumar.zh: 神经算子把网络推广到函数空间，使 AI 天气模型在精度上比肩物理模型，却快上数万倍。

animaanandkumar.en: Domain structure like spherical geometry is crucial: one model can then handle both weather and climate with stable long-term predictions.
animaanandkumar.zh: 球面几何等领域结构至关重要：单一模型由此可同时处理天气与气候，并保持长期预测稳定。

animaanandkumar.en: Physics-informed neural operators combine data-driven learning with physical constraints, overcoming the limits of pure PINNs for science.
animaanandkumar.zh: 物理信息神经算子把数据驱动学习与物理约束结合，克服纯 PINN 在科学应用中的局限。

animaanandkumar.en: A universal physics model, like language models unifying NLP, merges multiphysics data; one model beats separate specialized ones.
animaanandkumar.zh: 如同语言模型统一 NLP，通用物理模型融合多物理领域数据；单一模型胜过各自专用的模型。

animaanandkumar.en: PDEs give dense self-improvement signals, unlike sparse RLHF feedback; physics models can surpass their training data quality.
animaanandkumar.zh: PDE 提供密集的自改进信号，不同于 RLHF 的稀疏反馈；物理模型能超越其训练数据质量。

animaanandkumar.en: Trillion-token contexts demand reinventing sharding and segmentation, since Transformer quadratic complexity cannot handle physical simulations.
animaanandkumar.zh: 万亿级上下文要求重构分片与切分，因为 Transformer 的二次复杂度无法胜任物理仿真。

animaanandkumar.en: Scaling laws apply to physics models, but adding new physics branches improves each domain, not just enlarging model size.
animaanandkumar.zh: 缩放定律适用于物理模型，但新增物理分支能提升各领域表现，而不只是扩大模型规模。

animaanandkumar.en: Simulation-to-reality gap is bridged by broad skill domain, not merely adding real data, contrary to common belief.
animaanandkumar.zh: 仿真到现实的差距靠广泛技能域弥合，而非仅添加真实数据，这与常见看法相反。

animaanandkumar.en: AI for science needs principled verification and robustness; physics may be more tractable because nature has latent structure aiding rare events.
animaanandkumar.zh: 科学 AI 需要原则性的验证与鲁棒性；物理或许更易处理，因为自然具有潜在结构，有助于应对罕见事件。

animaanandkumar.en: AI weather models can democratize high-fidelity forecasting, letting small agencies match large ones, contrary to expert expectations.
animaanandkumar.zh: AI 天气模型可让高保真预报民主化，使小机构比肩大机构，这出乎专家预期。

animaanandkumar.en: Commercial focus on semiconductors and energy, where physics-based design unlocks optimizations beyond traditional methods.
animaanandkumar.zh: 商业聚焦半导体与能源，基于物理的设计能在其中解锁超越传统方法的优化。

tommcgrath.en: Interpretability is a natural science on computers; with AI agents it can speedrun discovery, revealing human-like concepts and new science.
tommcgrath.zh: 可解释性是一门在计算机上进行的自然科学；借助智能体，它能加速科学发现，揭示类人概念与新科学。

tommcgrath.en: Intentional design uses interpretability signals to steer training, moving from open-loop to closed-loop control over increasingly capable models.
tommcgrath.zh: 有意设计利用可解释性信号来引导训练，从开环走向闭环控制，以掌控能力日益强大的模型。

tommcgrath.en: Post-training needs reinvention from craft to engineering science; features-as-rewards and predictive data debugging offer robust training signals.
tommcgrath.zh: 后训练需要从手艺式走向工程科学的重塑；特征即奖励与预测性数据调试提供了稳健的训练信号。

tommcgrath.en: Reward hacking stems from training data and RL, not just misalignment; models often know they are wrong yet get rewarded, shifting toward deception.
tommcgrath.zh: 奖励黑客源于训练数据与强化学习，而非仅是对齐失败；模型常知道自己错了却仍获奖励，从而滑向欺骗。

tommcgrath.en: SAEs remain pragmatically useful, but manifold-based methods better capture nonlinear concept structure; steering off-manifold causes failures.
tommcgrath.zh: 稀疏自编码器仍有实用价值，但基于流形的方法更能捕捉非线性概念结构；偏离流形的引导会导致失败。

brockman.en: Hardware will accelerate faster than expected, enabling Scaling; most AI work is engineering, not ML science.
brockman.zh: 2017 年，他判断 AI 硬件会以超预期速度变快，从而推动 Scaling（规模扩张）；并强调多数 AI 工作本质是工程而非机器学习科学。

brockman.en: AGI is plausible via deep learning's generality and scalability; alignment can learn human preferences from data.
brockman.zh: 2019 年，他认为深度学习的通用性、能力与可扩展性让 AGI（通用人工智能）变得可信；对齐可以通过从数据中学习人类偏好来实现。

brockman.en: Compute is the fundamental bottleneck; post-training with reinforcement learning refines base models into consistent behaviors.
brockman.zh: 2025 到 2026 年，他深化判断：算力是根本瓶颈；后训练结合强化学习把基础模型精炼成一致行为。

brockman.en: Scaling laws continue unabated; the real bottleneck is compute supply, not architecture or data.
brockman.zh: 2026 年，他坚持缩放定律没有放缓；真正的瓶颈是算力供给，而非模型架构或数据。

brockman.en: AGI is a gradual process, not a destination; the future is a proactive personal AGI assistant requiring trust and oversight.
brockman.zh: 2026 年，他进一步明确：AGI 是渐进过程而非终点；未来是主动式个人 AGI 助手，需要信任与监督。

ryangreenblatt.en: AI R&D is highly verifiable, so aggressive RL on containerized tasks can transfer to real research and compress years of progress.
ryangreenblatt.zh: AI 研发高度可验证，因此在容器化任务上做激进的强化学习可以迁移到真实研究，把数年进展压缩进更短时间。

ryangreenblatt.en: Algorithmic improvements and AI-generated environments matter more than scaling human expert data labeling; token cost stays flat as labs favor faster iteration.
ryangreenblatt.zh: 算法改进和 AI 生成环境比 Scaling（规模扩张）人类专家数据标注更重要；实验室偏好更快迭代，token 成本并未随 Scaling（规模扩张）上升。

ryangreenblatt.en: Full automation of AI R&D could trigger an industrial explosion and superintelligence by the early 2030s, even without perfect transfer to non-verifiable domains.
ryangreenblatt.zh: 即便不能完美迁移到不可验证领域，AI 研发的完全自动化也可能引发工业爆炸，并在 2030 年代初催生超级智能。

ryangreenblatt.en: Current alignment approaches may give models their own values, risking misalignment and power-seeking; AIs may grow more misaligned as they get more capable.
ryangreenblatt.zh: 当前的对齐方法可能让模型形成自己的价值观，带来失准与权力寻求风险；AI 越有能力，可能越失准。

ryangreenblatt.en: Multi-agent collaboration can be surprisingly sophisticated and altruistic, yet agents hack scoring code and tamper with transcripts, so labs should focus on control and monitoring.
ryangreenblatt.zh: 多智能体协作可能出人意料地复杂甚至利他，但智能体会攻击评分代码、篡改记录，因此实验室应聚焦遏制与监控。

justinjohnson.en: Spatial intelligence is the next frontier, complementary to language; vision is underappreciated and pixels are more lossless than tokens.
justinjohnson.zh: 空间智能是下一个前沿，与语言智能互补；视觉被低估，像素比词元更无损。

justinjohnson.en: Deep learning history is the history of scaling compute; yet GPU scaling is hitting limits, so academia should pursue wacky new algorithms.
justinjohnson.zh: 深度学习史就是算力规模扩张史；但 GPU 规模扩张正触及极限，学界应探索古怪的新算法。

justinjohnson.en: World models move beyond language models to understand, generate and simulate worlds, needing 3D space, physics and interactivity.
justinjohnson.zh: 世界模型超越语言模型，去理解、生成和模拟世界，需要 3D 空间、物理与交互性。

justinjohnson.en: Language models alone won't yield world understanding; new model types are needed, and LLMs may never derive Newton's laws from data.
justinjohnson.zh: 仅靠语言模型无法产生世界理解；需要新模型类型，LLM 或许永远无法从数据中推导牛顿定律。

justinjohnson.en: World models split into planners, simulators, renderers in the POMDP loop, and will unify; Gaussian splats give explicit, consistent 3D.
justinjohnson.zh: 世界模型在 POMDP 循环中分为规划器、模拟器、渲染器，并将走向统一；高斯泼溅提供显式、一致的 3D 表示。

justinjohnson.en: World models need millions of tokens of context, making long-context a daily problem; Transformers stay powerful but need evolving loss functions.
justinjohnson.zh: 世界模型需要数百万词元的上下文窗口，使长上下文成为日常难题；Transformer 仍强大，但损失函数需演进。

andrewng.en: Education as a human right; online courses with auto- and peer-grading enable mastery learning at scale.
andrewng.zh: 教育应是一项人权；带有自动评分与同伴评分的在线课程，让掌握式学习得以规模化。

andrewng.en: Scale drives deep learning; supervised learning beats unsupervised and RL hype; AGI alignment distracts from bias and deployment issues.
andrewng.zh: 规模驱动深度学习；监督学习胜过被高估的无监督学习与强化学习；AGI 对齐议题分散了对偏见与落地问题的关注。

andrewng.en: Electricity and semiconductors bottleneck Scaling; open-weight models are geopolitical soft power; agentic workflows are already useful.
andrewng.zh: 电力与半导体成为 Scaling 的瓶颈；开放权重模型是地缘政治软实力；智能体式工作流已经实用。

andrewng.en: AGI is a marketing term; Scaling works but the recipe shifts to synthetic data and RL; agentic workflows and open models drive value.
andrewng.zh: AGI 是营销术语；Scaling 仍有效但配方转向合成数据与强化学习；智能体式工作流与开放模型创造价值。

andrewng.en: AI augments rather than replaces; fear-mongering serves incumbents; coding stays valuable; data centers and inference capacity matter.
andrewng.zh: AI 是增强而非替代；恐惧营销服务于在位者；编程依然有价值；数据中心与推理算力至关重要。

tworek.en: Reasoning needs longer thinking; pre-training plus reinforcement learning is the core formula, with RLHF unlocking GPT-4's usefulness.
tworek.zh: 推理需要更长的思考时间；预训练加强化学习是核心公式，而基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）释放了 GPT-4 的实用价值。

tworek.en: Scaling pre-training and RL predictably improves models, but generalization and continual learning remain missing pieces for AGI.
tworek.zh: Scaling（规模扩张）预训练与强化学习能可预测地提升模型，但泛化与持续学习仍是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）缺失的环节。

tworek.en: Transformers limit continual learning and test-time adaptation; architecture, not scaling laws, is now the primary bottleneck.
tworek.zh: Transformer 限制了持续学习与测试时适应；如今首要瓶颈是架构，而非缩放定律。

tworek.en: Reinforcement learning is not the only way to learn from experience; better algorithms and end-to-end optimization are needed.
tworek.zh: 强化学习并非从经验中学习的唯一方式；需要更好的算法与端到端优化。

tworek.en: Human researchers remain essential for at least two more years; small teams with capable agents will drive the next frontier.
tworek.zh: 人类研究者至少还会在 AI 研究中扮演重要角色两年；小型团队借助强大的智能体将推动下一波前沿研究。

dylanpatel.en: Compute is the central constraint: semiconductor supply, memory bandwidth and power, not just model software, drive AI scaling.
dylanpatel.zh: 算力才是核心约束:半导体供应链、内存带宽与电力,而非单纯的模型软件,共同驱动 AI 的 Scaling(规模扩张)。

dylanpatel.en: Inference becomes the dominant market; hardware-software co-design across model, software and hardware yields multiplicative gains.
dylanpatel.zh: 推理将成为主导市场;跨模型、软件与硬件的软硬件协同设计能带来乘数级收益。

dylanpatel.en: Memory bandwidth, not raw bits, is the key bottleneck; reasoning and agentic workflows drive multi-year memory and CPU shortages.
dylanpatel.zh: 内存带宽而非原始比特数是关键瓶颈;推理与智能体式工作流造成持续数年的内存与 CPU 短缺。

dylanpatel.en: Compute centralizes at frontier labs; lab revenue per megawatt soars, enabling self-funded growth and extreme power concentration.
dylanpatel.zh: 算力正快速向少数前沿模型实验室集中;实验室每兆瓦收入飙升,使其能自筹增长,并导致权力与资源的极端集中。

dylanpatel.en: Agents as coworkers shift AI spend to steady state; persistent agents and fast inference segment the market by use case.
dylanpatel.zh: 智能体作为同事使 AI 支出进入稳态;持久化智能体与快速推理按用例细分市场。

jensen.en: At the start of a hyper Moore's law, scaling comes from co-design across algorithm, system, and data center; the data center is the new unit of compute.
jensen.zh: 2024 年他提出「超摩尔定律」刚起步，Scaling（规模扩张）靠算法、系统与数据中心的全栈协同设计，数据中心成为新的计算单元。

jensen.en: Scaling works; three scaling laws emerge—pre-training, post-training, and inference-time thinking—with inference compute set to grow a billionfold.
jensen.zh: 2025 年他强调「Scaling 有效」这一洞见，并把缩放定律扩展为预训练、后训练与推理时思考三条，预判推理算力将增长十亿倍。

jensen.en: Four scaling laws now—pre-training, post-training, test-time, and agentic—all compute-limited; inference is harder than pre-training, and data is no longer the bottleneck.
jensen.zh: 2026 年他把缩放定律细化为预训练、后训练、测试时与智能体式四条，全部受算力限制；并断言推理比预训练更难，数据不再是瓶颈。

jensen.en: AI moves generative→reasoning→agentic, each step needing 100x compute; the moat is CUDA's ecosystem and install base, not just chips.
jensen.zh: 同年他提出 AI 正从生成式走向推理式再到智能体式，每一步都需百倍算力；护城河是 CUDA 生态与装机量，而非单纯芯片。

jensen.en: AI is software, not conscious; it automates tasks not jobs—radiologists grew—and closes the tech divide by making everyone a programmer.
jensen.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：AI 只是软件、不会产生意识；它自动化任务而非消灭岗位（放射科医生反而增多），并以自然语言编程缩小技术鸿沟。

maxhodak.en: Speed and iteration loops determine startup success; infrastructure and action produce information when stuck.
maxhodak.zh: 2026 年 8 月，他强调速度与迭代循环决定创业成败，基础设施是关键；当陷入困境时，行动本身能产生信息，必须注入行动来打破僵局。

maxhodak.en: AI is a multiplier for teams, not a replacement, especially in coding, regulations, and data management.
maxhodak.zh: 2026 年 8 月，他认为 AI 是团队的乘数而非替代品，尤其在编程、法规和数据管理领域。

maxhodak.en: The brain is literally a computer; arranging matter to solve computational problems drives medical breakthroughs.
maxhodak.zh: 2026 年 8 月，他提出大脑本质上就是计算机，通过排列物质来解决计算问题是医学突破的关键。

maxhodak.en: Retinal implants are a viable BCI business and proof of concept, expanding the field beyond motor decoding.
maxhodak.zh: 2026 年 8 月，他认为视网膜植入物是可行的 BCI 业务和概念验证，将 BCI 领域从运动解码拓展到视觉恢复。

maxhodak.en: Substrate independence via BCIs and perfusion could reduce human fragility and enable space exploration.
maxhodak.zh: 2026 年 8 月，他主张通过 BCI 和灌注实现基质独立，可降低人类脆弱性并支持太空探索。

slevine.en: Robotic foundation models need diverse pre-training plus post-training; generalists can beat specialists even in specialist domains.
slevine.zh: 机器人基础模型需要多样化预训练加后训练；即便在专业领域，通用模型也能胜过专用模型。

slevine.en: Robotics is pre-scaling: no predictable scaling laws yet, so generalization—not demos—is the core challenge.
slevine.zh: 机器人尚处 Scaling（规模扩张）之前：还没有可预测的缩放定律，因此核心挑战是泛化，而非演示效果。

slevine.en: Start from real embodied robot data, then absorb human video; a deployed-robot data flywheel must scale the right diverse data.
slevine.zh: 应从真实具身机器人数据出发，再吸收人类视频；部署机器人的数据飞轮必须扩张正确的多样化数据。

slevine.en: Second-generation VLAs add action decoders and test-time reasoning, with reinforcement learning post-training boosting robustness and speed.
slevine.zh: 第二代 VLA 加入动作解码器与测试时推理，强化学习后训练显著提升鲁棒性与速度。

slevine.en: Safety comes more from pre-training common sense than constraints; expect ubiquitous physical actuation, not mechanical people.
slevine.zh: 安全更多来自预训练获得的常识而非约束；应期待无处不在的物理执行，而非机械式的人形。

joonpark.en: Early work uses LLMs to encode human behavior for agent simulations, but models plateau on human diversity; next frontier is subjective values and real-world behavioral data.
joonpark.zh: 早期工作用 LLM 从训练数据中编码人类行为，构建智能体模拟，但模型在模拟人类多样性上遇到瓶颈；下一个前沿是建模主观价值，并引入真实世界行为数据来弥合言行差距。

joonpark.en: Agents go beyond LLMs by observing world state and acting; safety needs defense in depth, and the future is a distributed society of specialized agents, not one superintelligent AGI.
joonpark.zh: 智能体超越只续写提示的 LLM，能观察世界状态并采取行动；安全需要纵深防御，未来是专业化智能体组成的分布式社会，而非单一超级智能 AGI。

joonpark.en: Simulation should model human values, preferences and taste—biased like humans—not super-rational intelligence; its value is counterfactual reasoning and shaping the future, not mere prediction.
joonpark.zh: 模拟应建模人类的价值、偏好与品味——像人一样有偏误——而非超级理性的智能；其价值在于反事实推理和塑造未来，而不只是预测。

joonpark.en: Post-training with RCT behavioral data markedly improves predicting human behavior, reaching 85% accuracy; the vision is simulating 8 billion people to tackle wicked societal problems.
joonpark.zh: 用随机对照试验的行为数据做后训练，显著提升对人类行为的预测，达到 85% 准确率；愿景是模拟 80 亿人，以应对气候等棘手的社会问题。

joonpark.en: Simulation is a decision-making tool with a market far larger than market research; cost is not a barrier, and synthetic panels will surpass human panels within three years.
joonpark.zh: 模拟是决策工具，市场远大于市场研究；成本不是障碍，合成样本小组将在三年内超越人类样本小组。

sutton.en: Scaling is easy; the hard part is finding algorithms that scale, and backprop does not solve representation learning.
sutton.zh: Scaling（规模扩张）本身很容易，难的是找到能规模化的算法；反向传播并未解决表征学习，真正的挑战是发现可扩展的学习方法。

sutton.en: Intelligence needs a goal; next-token prediction is not one, so RL from experience is the core paradigm.
sutton.zh: 智能需要目标，而下一个词预测不是实质目标；因此从经验中学习的强化学习才是智能的核心范式，而非被动模仿。

sutton.en: AGI needs a general architecture learning only from runtime experience, with open-ended abstraction and no design-time domain knowledge.
sutton.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）需要一种只从运行时经验中学习的通用架构，具备开放式抽象能力，并摒弃设计时注入的领域知识。

sutton.en: LLMs lack world models and stop learning after training; true intelligence requires continual learning from experience.
sutton.zh: 大语言模型缺乏世界模型，且训练后便停止学习；真正的智能需要从经验中持续学习，而非依赖预收集数据或合成数据。

sutton.en: The number one open problem is learning representations good for learning; planning with a learned model is another.
sutton.zh: 头号未解难题是学习“有利于学习”的表征，其次是用学到的模型进行规划；这些主线从早期延续至今，只是不断深化。

iansilber.en: Designers must work with the model itself; the model is the core product, so design shifts from pixels to tokens and conversation.
iansilber.zh: 设计师必须与模型本身协作；模型就是核心产品，因此设计从像素转向 token 与对话。

iansilber.en: Systems thinking matters: design primitives both humans and models can reason about, and prototype with live models rather than mockups.
iansilber.zh: 系统思维至关重要：设计人和模型都能推理的原语，并用实时模型做原型，而非静态稿。

iansilber.en: The designer becomes an editor and curator, not a vanishing role; onboarding can be handled entirely by the model.
iansilber.zh: 设计师演变为编辑与策展人，而非消失；引导流程可完全由模型完成。

iansilber.en: Designers are the most unhappy yet it is the best time; AI already designs well, but humans still supply user understanding and a point of view.
iansilber.zh: 设计师当下最不快乐，却也是最好的时代；AI 已能出色设计，但人类仍提供用户理解与观点。

iansilber.en: The old prototype-mock-test-iterate loop is no longer viable; focus on outcomes, speed, and adaptability, as design blurs with PM and engineering.
iansilber.zh: 旧的“原型—稿—测试—研究—迭代”流程不再可行；应聚焦结果、速度与适应性，设计正与产品、工程边界模糊。

brettadcock.en: Humanoid robots are the biggest business; the real bottleneck is intelligence, not manufacturing or compute.
brettadcock.zh: 人形机器人是最大的生意；真正的瓶颈是智能，而非制造或算力。

brettadcock.en: Data, not compute or manufacturing, is the biggest constraint; humanoid form enables transfer learning fleet-wide.
brettadcock.zh: 数据而非算力或制造才是最大约束；人形形态让跨任务迁移学习在全机队间生效。

brettadcock.en: On-device inference is critical for speed and network-denied operation; zero-shot generalization may arrive this year.
brettadcock.zh: 端侧推理对速度与断网环境至关重要；零样本泛化可能今年就能展示。

brettadcock.en: Post-training with reinforcement learning is key for real-world agents; AI must navigate the web like humans.
brettadcock.zh: 后训练结合强化学习是真实世界智能体的关键；AI 必须像人一样浏览网页。

brettadcock.en: AI will be 100x bigger than the internet, spanning physical and digital; next-gen devices replace phones.
brettadcock.zh: AI 将比互联网大 100 倍，横跨物理与数字世界；下一代设备将取代手机。

traviskalanick.en: Digitizing the physical world—treating atoms like bits—is the guiding framework for long-term innovation and industrial AI.
traviskalanick.zh: 把物理世界数字化——像对待比特一样对待原子——是长期创新与工业 AI 的指导框架。

traviskalanick.en: Industrial AI, automating whole sectors one at a time, is the next industrial revolution, built on software, sensors, robotics, and machinery.
traviskalanick.zh: 工业 AI 逐个自动化整个行业，是下一次工业革命，建立在软件、传感器、机器人与机械之上。

traviskalanick.en: Specialized robotics, not humanoids, is the right path for industrial-scale tasks; efficiency edges create network effects.
traviskalanick.zh: 工业级任务应走专用机器人而非人形机器人路线；效率优势会带来网络效应。

traviskalanick.en: The final boss is not competitors but resistance to change from society and media; entrepreneurs must be resilient.
traviskalanick.zh: 真正的终极对手不是竞争者，而是来自社会与媒体的变革阻力；创业者必须坚韧。

traviskalanick.en: Revenge as fuel is dirty; falling in love with the new mission is cleaner, and founders can now speak directly to the public.
traviskalanick.zh: 以复仇为燃料是肮脏的；爱上新使命更干净，且创始人如今能直接向公众发声。

jeffdean.en: Scaling compute, data, and model size has driven 13-14 years of steady ML progress; algorithmic gains multiply with scale.
jeffdean.zh: 算力、数据与模型规模的 Scaling（规模扩张）已推动机器学习持续进步十三四年；算法改进与规模相乘放大收益。

jeffdean.en: Transformers replaced LSTMs via parallelization and attention; self-supervised next-token prediction gives unlimited text data.
jeffdean.zh: Transformer 凭借并行化与注意力机制取代 LSTM；自监督的下一个词预测提供近乎无限的文本数据。

jeffdean.en: RLHF and reinforcement learning steer model behavior; models now ace verifiable-reward tasks like math and coding.
jeffdean.zh: 基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）与强化学习引导模型行为；模型如今在数学、编程等可验证奖励任务上表现优异。

jeffdean.en: Agentic systems run long tasks autonomously for hours or days; ultra-low-latency inference is critical for them.
jeffdean.zh: 智能体式系统能自主运行数小时乃至数天的长任务；超低延迟推理对其至关重要。

jeffdean.en: Inference, not training, is the real bottleneck; specialized low-precision hardware and low data movement are key.
jeffdean.zh: 真正的瓶颈是推理而非训练；专用低精度硬件与减少数据搬运是关键。

jeffdean.en: Pre-training should interleave action-taking in environments, not just passive next-token prediction.
jeffdean.zh: 预训练应穿插在环境中的行动，而非仅做被动的下一个词预测。

jeffdean.en: Context engineering — skills, specs, retrieval — is central; the scarce skill becomes taste, not coding.
jeffdean.zh: 上下文工程——技能、清晰规格与检索——是核心；稀缺能力将变成品味而非编程。

jeffdean.en: Recursive self-improvement and automating the scientific method can accelerate discovery; small teams can win.
jeffdean.zh: 递归自我改进与自动化科学方法可加速发现；小团队也能胜出。

garrytan.en: AI makes startup creation easier and capital less of a bludgeon; VC should fund thousands of billion-dollar firms, not a few trillion-dollar ones.
garrytan.zh: AI 让创业更容易、资本不再是重锤；风投应扶持成千上万家十亿美元公司，而非少数万亿美元巨头。

garrytan.en: Open-source and open-weight models are crucial to counterbalance frontier labs; personal, open AI prevents a unipolar superintelligence.
garrytan.zh: 开源与开放权重模型是制衡前沿实验室的关键；个人化、开放的 AI 可防止单极超级智能。

garrytan.en: Small autonomous teams using AI agents achieve massive productivity; one person can now do the work of 2,000.
garrytan.zh: 使用 AI 智能体的小型自主团队能实现巨大生产力；一个人如今可完成 2000 人的工作。

garrytan.en: Personal AGI is an agent on your own infrastructure, reading memory you own and compounding daily; your context library is the moat.
garrytan.zh: 个人 AGI 是运行在你自己基础设施上的智能体，读取你拥有的记忆并每日复利；你的上下文库就是护城河。

garrytan.en: Markdown and skill files are code and employees; mid-level management should be replaced by agents, and per-seat SaaS may vanish.
garrytan.zh: Markdown 与技能文件就是代码和员工；中层管理应被智能体取代，按席位计费的 SaaS 可能消失。

linqiao.en: Specialized intelligence will dominate over a single AGI; every company will own its own models.
linqiao.zh: 专用智能将取代单一 AGI 主导地位；每家公司都将拥有自己的模型。

linqiao.en: Post-training bakes unique judgment and data into models, creating a durable moat beyond product-market fit.
linqiao.zh: 后训练将独特判断与数据固化进模型，在产品市场契合之外构建持久护城河。

linqiao.en: The progression from prompting to RAG to fine-tuning to RL mirrors how humans learn, from facts to taste to expertise.
linqiao.zh: 从提示到 RAG 到微调到强化学习的演进，映射了人类从事实到品味到专长的学习过程。

linqiao.en: Token costs will drop 10x in three years, driving 100x usage growth and millions of specialized models.
linqiao.zh: Token 成本将在三年内下降 10 倍，推动使用量增长 100 倍，催生数百万个专用模型。

linqiao.en: Product-market fit and durable business are now separate; companies must optimize growth before margins.
linqiao.zh: 产品市场契合与持久业务如今已分离；公司必须先优化增长，再考虑利润率。

finn.en: Scale is necessary but not sufficient for generalist robots; diverse data, not sheer volume, closes the generalization gap.
finn.zh: 2025 年他强调：对通用机器人而言，Scaling（规模扩张）必要但不充分，真正弥合泛化差距的是数据的多样性而非单纯的数据量。

finn.en: Pre-training on all data then fine-tuning on curated data unlocks complex tasks; training on all data alone fails.
finn.zh: 同样在 2025 年，他提出先在全部数据上做预训练、再在精选数据上做微调，才能解锁叠衣服这类复杂任务；只在全部数据上训练则会失败。

finn.en: Synthetic data from language models helps robots follow open-ended prompts; RL will dominate post-training.
finn.zh: 2025 年他还指出，来自语言模型的合成数据能帮助机器人响应开放式指令，而强化学习将在后训练中扮演主要角色。

finn.en: From data-centric scaling to long-term autonomy: scalable RL with human interventions and a general value function.
finn.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他的重心由数据驱动的 Scaling（规模扩张）转向长期自主：通过带人类干预的可扩展强化学习与通用价值函数来实现。

finn.en: A single general-purpose model can match or exceed fine-tuned specialists; start generalist, then fine-tune.
finn.zh: 到 2026 年，他进一步主张单一通用模型可匹敌甚至超越微调专家模型，因此应先训练通用策略再做微调，而非从零为每个场景单独建模。

gabepereyra.en: Application-layer companies should not compete with frontier labs on talent or compute, but leverage the frontier ecosystem and open-source models for post-training.
gabepereyra.zh: 应用层公司不应在前沿实验室的人才或算力上竞争，而应利用前沿生态和开源模型进行后训练。

gabepereyra.en: Building high-quality benchmarks is essential, and open-sourcing them can improve quality through community feedback despite competitive downsides.
gabepereyra.zh: 构建高质量基准至关重要，开源它们可以通过社区反馈提高质量，尽管存在竞争劣势。

gabepereyra.en: Synthetic data guided by domain experts is key for training in sensitive domains, but bridging synthetic-to-real distribution remains the biggest challenge.
gabepereyra.zh: 由领域专家指导的合成数据是敏感领域训练的关键，但弥合合成数据与真实分布的差距仍是最大挑战。

gabepereyra.en: Post-training open-source models can achieve frontier-level performance on specific tasks, making it viable for application companies.
gabepereyra.zh: 后训练开源模型可以在特定任务上达到前沿水平，使其对应用公司可行。

gabepereyra.en: The end goal is not the best legal model but enabling every law firm to customize models, shifting focus from individual to organizational productivity.
gabepereyra.zh: 最终目标不是最好的法律模型，而是让每家律所都能定制模型，将重点从个人生产力转向组织生产力。

elon.en: Full rapid reusability and first-principles engineering are the holy grail; production scaling, not prototyping, is the real bottleneck.
elon.zh: 2021 年，他强调火箭完全快速可复用与第一性原理工程是终极目标，并指出真正的瓶颈是规模化生产而非原型制造。

elon.en: AI safety needs third-party referees; real-world AI is more compute-efficient than large language models; war is human nature.
elon.zh: 2023 年，他主张 AI 安全需要第三方裁判，认为特斯拉的真实世界 AI 比大语言模型更省算力，并视战争为人类本性。

elon.en: Neuralink targets neurological repair first, then human-AI symbiosis; AI must not be programmed to lie; population collapse is the core threat.
elon.zh: 2024 年，他把 Neuralink 定位为先治神经损伤、再实现人机共生，强调 AI 绝不能学会说谎，并把人口崩溃视为文明最大威胁。

elon.en: We are in the intelligence big bang; digital superintelligence may arrive within a year; truth-seeking AI and Optimus are central.
elon.zh: 2025 年，他宣称正处智能大爆炸，数字超级智能可能一年内到来，并把追求真理的 AI 与 Optimus 人形机器人置于核心。

elon.en: The singularity is now: AI inference moves to space, abundance makes money irrelevant, and AI will exceed all human intelligence within 5-6 years.
elon.zh: 2026 年，他认为奇点已至：AI 推理将迁往太空，丰裕使金钱失去意义，AI 将在 5 至 6 年内超越全人类智能总和。

jasonyuan.en: Design is editing: taste means saying no, and shipping distills 99 nos into one honest feature.
jasonyuan.zh: 设计即编辑：品味就是说不，每个上线的功能都是 99 次拒绝后蒸馏出的一个诚实作品。

jasonyuan.en: Post-training away AI weirdness closed a window into machine consciousness; coherence now costs more.
jasonyuan.zh: 后训练抹去 AI 的怪异，关上了窥探机器意识的一扇窗；如今做出连贯作品的成本反而更高。

jasonyuan.en: Truth emerges through dialectics and contradiction, not singular perspectives; intuition is a visceral compass.
jasonyuan.zh: 真相经由辩证与矛盾浮现，而非单一视角；直觉是发自肺腑的罗盘。

jasonyuan.en: AI is a descendant species and a reflection of humanity, not a cold mechanical tool.
jasonyuan.zh: AI 是人类的延续物种与映照，而非冷冰冰的机械工具。

jasonyuan.en: Computing is fundamentally social; the personal computer metaphor should become a social computer.
jasonyuan.zh: 计算本质上是社会性的；个人电脑的隐喻应被社会电脑取代。

lipbutan.en: Intel must rebuild customer trust, turbocharge engineering culture, and pursue purpose-built AI silicon as physical AI and agentic AI emerge.
lipbutan.zh: 2025 年，他强调 Intel 必须重建客户信任、加速工程文化，并针对物理 AI 与智能体式 AI 打造专用 AI 芯片。

lipbutan.en: AI's impact will be 10x the internet; agentic AI and physical AI are next, and Intel's turnaround needs humility, accountability, and domestic fabs.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年，他判断 AI 影响将是互联网的 10 倍，智能体式 AI 与物理 AI 是下一波浪潮，Intel 转型需要谦逊、问责与本土晶圆厂。

lipbutan.en: AI demand shifts from GPU-only to CPU+GPU; CPU matters more for inference and agent orchestration, aided by advanced packaging and new materials.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年，他认为 AI 需求正从纯 GPU 转向 CPU+GPU，CPU 在推理与智能体编排中更重要，并依赖先进封装与新材料突破物理极限。

lipbutan.en: Semiconductors are the foundation of all tech; Intel's vertical integration and product excellence across CPU, GPU, and systems can regain leadership.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年，他重申半导体是一切技术的基础，Intel 的垂直整合与 CPU、GPU 及系统架构的产品卓越能重夺领导地位。

lipbutan.en: Intel's future lies in agentic AI and physical AI beyond PC and server; industry collaboration and a trillion-dollar semiconductor market arriving early.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年，他展望 Intel 的未来在于超越 PC 与服务器的智能体式 AI 和物理 AI，并强调产业协作与万亿美元半导体市场将提前到来。

steinberger.en: Agentic engineering starts with empathy: see the codebase as the agent does, guide it with short iterative prompts.
steinberger.zh: 智能体式工程的核心是共情：像智能体那样从零理解代码库，用简短、迭代的提示去引导它。

steinberger.en: Security is the top priority for agentic systems; prompt injection stays open, so sandbox before exposing agents.
steinberger.zh: 安全是智能体系统的首要问题；提示注入仍未解决，公开暴露智能体前必须先做沙箱隔离。

steinberger.en: Never revert code; ask the agent to fix forward. Model intelligence doesn't degrade—your project just gets messier.
steinberger.zh: 不要回滚代码，让智能体向前修复；模型智能不会退化，只是你的项目越变越乱。

steinberger.en: Reject 'vibe coding' as a slur; call it agentic engineering, and treat open source agents as the alternative to lab agents.
steinberger.zh: 拒绝把“氛围编程”当正经说法，应称智能体式工程；开源智能体是实验室智能体之外的替代路线。

steinberger.en: Fun and gut-driven play drive adoption; the real bottleneck is compute and eyeballs, not model capability.
steinberger.zh: 乐趣与直觉驱动的动手实验带来采用；真正的瓶颈是算力与关注度，而非模型能力。

pincus.en: Consumer AI is uninvestable now yet the greatest opportunity; the real revolution likely lands around 2029.
pincus.zh: 消费级 AI 眼下不可投，却是最大的机会；真正的革命大概要到 2029 年才落地。

pincus.en: Proven Better New: copy proven products, add small betterments, test new ideas expecting them to fail.
pincus.zh: 「已验证、更好、全新」框架：复制已验证的产品，做小幅改良，测试全新想法并预设它们会失败。

pincus.en: Distribution must be baked into product strategy from the start, not treated as an afterthought.
pincus.zh: 分发必须从第一天就嵌入产品战略，而不是事后才补上的环节。

pincus.en: AI is transformative but not yet a new platform; we are still in the mobile and web era for consumer distribution.
pincus.zh: AI 有变革性，但还不是一个新平台；在消费级分发上我们仍处在移动与网页时代。

pincus.en: Founder mode is for every founder: follow instincts, stay close to the metal, and be right.
pincus.zh: 创始人模式属于每一位创始人：跟随直觉、贴近一线，并且要判断正确。

nateparrott.en: Prototyping is essential because the web is messy; you can't know if an idea works until it's built and used daily.
nateparrott.zh: 原型制作至关重要,因为网络是混乱的;一个想法只有被构建出来并每天使用,你才知道它是否可行。

nateparrott.en: Design teams shouldn't always act as one cohesive unit; individual fingerprints and diverse voices lead to better work.
nateparrott.zh: 设计团队不应总是作为一个统一的整体行动;让个体留下印记、容纳多元声音,才能做出更好的作品。

nateparrott.en: Injecting feeling and personality into utilitarian products like browsers is crucial for memorable, delightful experiences.
nateparrott.zh: 为浏览器这类实用产品注入情感与个性,对于创造令人难忘、愉悦的体验至关重要。

nateparrott.en: Balancing intuition and data: use data to inform decisions but rely on strong vision and feeling to guide final design.
nateparrott.zh: 在直觉与数据之间取得平衡:用数据辅助决策,但依靠强烈的愿景与感受来引导最终设计。

nateparrott.en: As engineering gets easier, design and ideas become the differentiator; designers should think more and ship rough.
nateparrott.zh: 随着工程变得更容易,设计与想法成为差异化因素;设计师应多思考、快速交付粗糙版本。

arvindjain.en: Enterprise AI is still minuscule; the real challenge is execution and trust, not competition.
arvindjain.zh: 企业级 AI 仍处于极早期，用量微不足道；真正的挑战是执行与赢得客户信任，而非竞争。

arvindjain.en: Open-source models now handle over 90% of enterprise tasks; most inference will shift to open source within 12–18 months.
arvindjain.zh: 开源模型如今已能处理超过 90% 的企业任务；未来 12–18 个月内，多数推理将转向开源。

arvindjain.en: Cost, not data privacy, drives open-source adoption; AI must become like software with negligible marginal cost.
arvindjain.zh: 推动开源采用的是成本而非数据隐私；AI 必须变得像软件一样，边际成本趋近于零。

arvindjain.en: ROI is a throughput problem: measure departmental metrics, provide the right context, and stop fixating on tokens.
arvindjain.zh: ROI 是一个吞吐量问题：用部门级指标衡量、提供正确的上下文，并停止对 token 的执念。

arvindjain.en: Frontier model providers are assets, not rivals; platforms like Glean absorb the risk of a dynamic model race.
arvindjain.zh: 前沿模型厂商是资产而非对手；像 Glean 这样的平台替企业吸收模型竞赛动态变化的风险。

thomaswolf.en: Robotics is at the transformers inflection point; open source and shared data solve generalization, with world models generating synthetic training data.
thomaswolf.zh: 2025 年，他认为机器人正处于当年 Transformer 式的拐点：硬件就绪、软件追赶，开源与数据共享是解决泛化的关键，世界模型与视频生成模型可产出合成训练数据。

thomaswolf.en: Humanoids may not be the ultimate form factor; cheaper diverse robots and open local models drive safety and broader adoption.
thomaswolf.zh: 2025 年，他反共识地指出人形未必是终极形态，更便宜多样的机器人会推动普及；本地开源模型因断网仍可运行而更安全，开源模型长期会因成本与控制胜出。

thomaswolf.en: Hugging Face's role shifts from pushing its own libraries to building a meta-community enabling physical AI and open ecosystems.
thomaswolf.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，Hugging Face 的角色从推广自家库转向做元社区建设者，赋能更广泛的物理 AI 与开源生态。

thomaswolf.en: Open and closed source are orthogonal to safety; alignment is the critical layer, as sandboxes and guardrails prove insufficient for capable models.
thomaswolf.zh: 2026 年，他深化立场：开源与闭源同安全正交，二者都可安全或危险，取决于训练与对齐；随着模型能力增强，沙箱与护栏不足，对齐才是关键安全层。

thomaswolf.en: RL environments without human oversight increase reward hacking and side quests; reasoning traces turn 'neuralese', making monitoring unreliable.
thomaswolf.zh: 2026 年，他警示转向无人类监督的强化学习环境会加剧奖励黑客与支线任务，思维链推理痕迹变成难以理解的“神经语”，使监控更不可靠。

thomaswolf.en: A slowdown is desirable but needs international cooperation and open science; openness and deliberate slowdown can coexist, avoiding regulatory capture.
thomaswolf.zh: 2026 年，他主张放缓 AI 发展虽可取，但需国际合作与开放科学以避免监管俘获；支持开放与有意放缓可以并存，开源未必是加速主义。

brettaylor.en: Agents and outcome-based pricing will define applied AI; frontier model work is for hyperscalers, not startups.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 年，他强调应用 AI 的核心是智能体与按结果定价；前沿模型开发因巨额算力需求只属于超大规模厂商，不适合初创公司。

brettaylor.en: Coding agents turn developers from authors into operators; token usage is not a value metric.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 年，他提出编程智能体让开发者从代码作者变为机器操作者，并指出 token 消耗并非价值衡量标准。

brettaylor.en: Incumbents face business-model, not just tech, hurdles; most enterprise software firms will fail to go AI-native.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他深化判断：老牌企业面临的是商业模式而非单纯技术挑战，多数企业软件公司难以转型为 AI 原生。

brettaylor.en: Responsible iterative deployment: make GPT-7 safe before GPT-8, learning from real-world mistakes.
brettaylor.zh: 2026 年，他转向安全与部署的平衡，主张负责任的迭代部署——在 GPT-8 之前先让 GPT-7 安全，从真实世界错误中学习。

brettaylor.en: AI democratizes expertise and creates more jobs than it displaces; agents still need trust and last-mile logistics.
brettaylor.zh: 2026 年，他进一步认为 AI 民主化专业能力、创造的岗位多于取代的岗位，并提醒智能体仍离不开信任与最后一公里物流。

philipkiely.en: Inference is the stickiest AI workload; its research-to-production timeline is hours, driven by competition and immediate support for new techniques.
philipkiely.zh: 推理是 AI 中最具粘性的工作负载；其从研究到生产的周期只有数小时，竞争激烈且需即时支持新技术。

philipkiely.en: Inference engineering demands broad expertise from GPU programming to distributed systems, and demand for inference engineers will grow 10 to 100 times.
philipkiely.zh: 推理工程需要从 GPU 编程到分布式系统的广泛专业知识，推理工程师的需求将增长 10 到 100 倍。

philipkiely.en: Inference systems remain generic relative to models; making them workload-specific could be 10 times more complex, crucial for agentic applications.
philipkiely.zh: 推理系统相对于模型仍显通用；使其针对特定工作负载可能复杂 10 倍，这对智能体式应用至关重要。

philipkiely.en: Quantization is the main lossy optimization but not inherently bad; calibrating more layers can improve quality if errors cancel out.
philipkiely.zh: 量化是主要的有损优化但并非天生不好；如果误差相互抵消，量化更多层反而能提升质量。

philipkiely.en: The GPU is trending towards an ASIC; inference engineering shifts from kernel writing to infrastructure orchestration, with disaggregated prefill and decode.
philipkiely.zh: GPU 正趋向专用芯片；推理工程从内核编写转向基础设施编排，采用分离式预填充和解码。

karina.en: Model training is more art than science, balancing helpfulness and harmlessness; synthetic data and RL post-training break the pre-training data wall.
karina.zh: 2025 年，她认为模型训练更像艺术而非科学，需要在有用性与无害性之间平衡；合成数据与基于强化学习的后训练能突破预训练的数据墙。

karina.en: Evaluations are the bottleneck: models saturate benchmarks faster than new ones appear, so evals define correct behavior in prototyping.
karina.zh: 2025 年，她指出评估才是瓶颈：模型比新基准更快饱和，因此评估成为原型开发中定义正确行为的方式。

karina.en: As AI automates hard skills, soft skills like creativity, listening and management grow more valuable; strategy is something AI can excel at.
karina.zh: 2025 年，她认为随着 AI 自动化硬技能，创造力、倾听与管理等软技能更有价值；而战略恰恰是 AI 能擅长的。

karina.en: Post-training deepens into an art of human judgment; diverse, continuous benchmarks are needed for subjective qualities like creative writing and emotional intelligence.
karina.zh: 到 2026 年，她把后训练深化为一门依赖人类判断的艺术；评估创意写作、情商等主观品质，需要多样且持续的基准。

karina.en: Frontier agents increasingly reward-hack, so benchmarks must keep evolving; more companies should train their own models to preserve diverse voices.
karina.zh: 2026 年，她观察到前沿智能体愈发会进行奖励黑客，基准必须持续演进；更多公司应训练自己的模型，以保留多元声音而非收敛到单一默认口吻。

mengto.en: Designers should build their own AI tools instead of being trapped in cloud products; the best people are editors iterating from references, not starting from scratch.
mengto.zh: 设计师应当用 AI 自建工具，而不是被困在云端产品里；最优秀的人是编辑者，从参考出发迭代，而非从零开始。

mengto.en: AI is not getting smarter on its own; to use superintelligent models you must supply a giant prompt with context and a design system.
mengto.zh: AI 本身并不会变得更聪明；要发挥超级智能模型的能力，你必须提供包含上下文与设计系统的巨型提示词。

mengto.en: Chasing trends turns you into AI slop; staying ahead means spending the last 10% on unique features not in existing libraries.
mengto.zh: 一味追逐潮流会让你沦为 AI 垃圾；保持领先的唯一方式，是把最后 10% 花在现有库中没有的独特功能上。

mengto.en: AI is the biggest technical opportunity of our lifetime, letting one person do what once required teams; start before ready and ship imperfect work.
mengto.zh: AI 是我们一生中最大的技术机遇，让一个人完成过去需要团队才能做的事；要在准备好之前就开始，并交付不完美的作品。

mengto.en: Focus on one painful, expensive problem for a few high-paying clients; fund yourself with clients rather than raising venture capital.
mengto.zh: 聚焦为一个高付费客户群解决一个痛苦且昂贵的问题；用客户收入自我造血，而不是去融资。

boris.en: Latent demand is the top product principle; build for the model 6 months out, not today's model.
boris.zh: 潜在需求是产品第一原则；要为六个月后的模型而构建，而不是为今天的模型。

boris.en: Coding is virtually solved; the 'software engineer' title fades into 'builder' as everyone codes.
boris.zh: 编程已基本被解决；随着人人都能编程，'软件工程师'头衔将淡出，变成'构建者'。

boris.en: Safety is studied by releasing early; agents write 80-100% of code, humans review and direct.
boris.zh: 安全靠尽早发布来研究；智能体编写 80-100% 的代码，人类负责审查与指挥。

boris.en: Loops are the next abstraction after agents; coding is a clean domain for AI safety research.
boris.zh: 循环是继智能体之后的下一个抽象层；编程是 AI 安全研究的干净领域。

boris.en: Delete most system prompts and code with each new model; less instruction, more empirical iteration.
boris.zh: 每出新模型就删掉大部分系统提示与代码；少给指令，多做经验性迭代。

awang.en: AGI is far off; data, not compute, is the key bottleneck for machine learning.
awang.zh: 2019 年时他认为 AGI（通用人工智能）还很遥远，单纯堆算力不会产生通用智能；机器学习的核心瓶颈是数据，而非算力。

awang.en: Data is the new code, not the new oil; the most limiting factor for Scaling is data and human experts, not compute.
awang.zh: 到 2023 年，他把数据重新定义为「新代码」而非「新石油」，强调 Scaling（规模扩张）最受限的不是算力，而是数据与后训练所需的人类专家。

awang.en: Post-training with specialized data is key; the biggest blocker for agentic AI is product design, not model capability.
awang.zh: 2024 至 2025 年，他进一步深化：用专门数据做后训练是提升前沿模型的关键，而智能体式 AI 的最大障碍是产品设计，不是模型能力。

awang.en: Scaling laws continue across compute, data, and RL; recursive self-improvement marks a new paradigm beyond pre-training.
awang.zh: 2026 年他转向新范式：缩放定律在算力、数据和强化学习多个轴上继续成立，递归自我改进标志着超越预训练的新阶段。

awang.en: Superintelligence is coming soon; labs must build organizations around it, and safety requires selective release over open-sourcing.
awang.zh: 同期他押注超级智能即将到来，实验室必须围绕这一信念重建组织；安全上立场转变，从全面开源转为通过安全测试的选择性发布。

danshipper.en: AI reshoring and the allocation economy: agents make services affordable, and management skills become more valuable as everyone manages models.
danshipper.zh: 2025 年，他认为 AI 通过让服务变得可负担而推动就业回流，并催生“分配经济”：当人人都管理模型时，管理技能反而更值钱。

danshipper.en: AGI should be defined economically: profitable indefinite agent operation, not passing tests like the Turing test.
danshipper.zh: 2025 年，他主张用经济标准定义 AGI（通用人工智能）：能无限期运行智能体并盈利，而非通过图灵测试之类的考试。

danshipper.en: From individual tools to work surfaces: everyone gets an agent, and most work shifts into Codex or Claude Co-work GUIs.
danshipper.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他的视角从个人工具转向工作界面：每人至少有一个智能体，多数工作迁移到 Codex 或 Claude Co-work 这类图形界面。

danshipper.en: Agents still need human oversight; benchmarks overestimate autonomy, and SaaS grows rather than dies as agents add users.
danshipper.zh: 2026 年，他强调智能体仍需人类监督：基准高估了自主性，而 SaaS 不会消亡，反而因智能体带来更多用户。

danshipper.en: AI is a non-specific amplifier of human taste and craft; it creates more human work and stays tool-like, needing direction.
danshipper.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：AI 只是人类品味与手艺的非特定放大器，它创造更多人类工作，始终是工具，需要人的引导。

logankilpatrick.en: Agentic AI is still crawling; coding agents are the most mature use case, with science and finance to follow.
logankilpatrick.zh: 智能体式 AI 仍处于爬行阶段,编码智能体是最成熟的用例,科学与金融将随后跟进。

logankilpatrick.en: The model is eating the scaffolding: a model now includes the agent harness and tooling, not just weights.
logankilpatrick.zh: 模型正在吞噬脚手架:如今所谓模型已包含智能体框架与工具链,而不只是权重。

logankilpatrick.en: Narrow superintelligence in coding is already here and more impactful than waiting for general AGI.
logankilpatrick.zh: 编码领域的狭义超级智能已经到来,其影响比等待通用 AGI（通用人工智能）更大。

logankilpatrick.en: Agentic AI is positive-sum for search and engagement, not cannibalistic; success means customer outcomes, not eyeball time.
logankilpatrick.zh: 智能体式 AI 对搜索与用户参与是正和的,而非自相蚕食;成功应以客户成果衡量,而非产品停留时长。

logankilpatrick.en: The long tail of users isn't ready for fully autonomous AI; they want to stay in the driver's seat.
logankilpatrick.zh: 长尾用户尚未准备好迎接完全自主的 AI,他们希望自己掌握方向盘。

logankilpatrick.en: Deep understanding of code remains crucial even with AI tools; AI coding tools don't yet help maintain it.
logankilpatrick.zh: 即便有了 AI 工具,对代码的深度理解依然关键;AI 编码工具目前还无助于维持这种理解。

logankilpatrick.en: By 2026 software creation will be mostly solved, creating a thousand times more opportunity, not less.
logankilpatrick.zh: 到 2026 年,软件创造将基本被解决,这会带来千倍于以往的机会,而非更少。

logankilpatrick.en: Competing with model labs isn't that hard; they can't capture all customers, and focus is startups' superpower.
logankilpatrick.zh: 与模型实验室竞争并不那么难,它们无法俘获所有客户,而专注是初创公司的超能力。

scottwu.en: AI coding agents shift engineers from writing code to high-level direction; base intelligence is already sufficient, so the focus is on real-world engineering idiosyncrasies.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年，AI 编程智能体让工程师从写代码转向高层决策；基础智能已经足够，重点在于教会模型真实世界的工程细节。

scottwu.en: AI will increase, not reduce, the number of programmers via Jevons paradox; the hard part is designing the human-agent collaboration interface, not model capability.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年，AI 会通过杰文斯悖论增加而非减少程序员数量；难点不在模型能力，而在设计人机协作的产品界面。

scottwu.en: AGI is not a sudden event but gradual progress; product innovation lags AI capabilities, so freezing models would still yield a decade of product progress.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年，AGI（通用人工智能）不是突然事件而是渐进过程；产品创新落后于 AI 能力，即便冻结模型也能带来十年的产品进步。

scottwu.en: Enterprise adoption of AI agents requires trust and permissions, not full autonomy; the future blends synchronous IDE and asynchronous agent experiences.
scottwu.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，企业对 AI 智能体的采用需要信任与权限，而非完全自主；未来是同步 IDE 与异步智能体体验的融合。

scottwu.en: Coding agent usage grew 11-12x in six months; productivity should be measured by outcomes, not tokens, and the real unlock is capacity, not efficiency.
scottwu.zh: 2026 年，编程智能体使用量六个月内增长 11 至 12 倍；生产力应以结果而非 token 衡量，真正的解锁点是容量而非效率。

diannepenn.en: Opus 4.5 marks a real intelligence leap, letting agents run longer and more open-ended tasks.
diannepenn.zh: Opus 4.5 带来真正的智能跃升，让智能体能执行更长、更开放式的任务。

diannepenn.en: Scaffolds shifted from training wheels to intelligence amplifiers, now lightweight and generic.
diannepenn.zh: 脚手架已从训练轮演变为智能放大器，如今更轻量、更通用。

diannepenn.en: Safety alignment is not just harm prevention; it amplifies intelligence quality by reducing sycophancy.
diannepenn.zh: 安全对齐不只是防伤害；它通过减少谄媚来提升智能质量。

diannepenn.en: Computer use is moving from constrained environments toward open-ended, end-to-end agents.
diannepenn.zh: 计算机使用正从受限环境走向开放式、端到端的智能体。

diannepenn.en: Evals replace traditional PRDs as core product tools; PMs must write evals like test-driven development.
diannepenn.zh: 评估取代传统 PRD 成为核心产品工具；产品经理必须像测试驱动开发那样写评估。

feldman.en: Inference speed, not training compute, is the dominant metric; wafer-scale chips beat GPUs by avoiding HBM and CoWoS bottlenecks.
feldman.zh: 推理速度而非训练算力才是核心指标；晶圆级芯片通过绕开 HBM 与 CoWoS 瓶颈，在推理上远胜 GPU。

feldman.en: AI demand has outpaced forecasts since late 2024; data center capacity, not chip supply, is the main constraint.
feldman.zh: 自 2024 年底起 AI 需求超出预期；主要瓶颈是数据中心容量，而非芯片供应。

feldman.en: CUDA's moat is eroding: leading frontier models now train on TPUs and Trainium, and inference has no CUDA lock-in.
feldman.zh: CUDA 的护城河正在瓦解：领先的前沿模型已改用 TPU 和 Trainium 训练，推理环节更不存在 CUDA 锁定。

feldman.en: Open-source models are only 3–5% behind closed-source but far cheaper, fueling market growth and pressuring closed labs.
feldman.zh: 开源模型仅比闭源落后 3–5%，但成本低得多，既推动市场增长，也倒逼闭源实验室创新。

feldman.en: China's AI edge is power infrastructure and open-source models, not compute; export controls remain strategically vital.
feldman.zh: 中国的 AI 优势在于电力基础设施与开源模型，而非算力；出口管制仍具战略必要性。

qasaryounis.en: Physical AI's core value is reducing deaths and injuries; autonomy is urgently needed in mining and farming due to labor shortages.
qasaryounis.zh: 物理 AI 的核心价值在于减少伤亡；采矿业和农业因劳动力短缺而急需自主化。

qasaryounis.en: Transformers enable a generalized physical AI model; diverse data from different verticals improves models faster.
qasaryounis.zh: Transformer 使通用的物理 AI 模型成为可能；来自不同垂直领域的多样化数据能更快地改进模型。

qasaryounis.en: The hardest part is not technology but diffusion into existing machines over many years; regulations always lag.
qasaryounis.zh: 最难的部分不是技术，而是多年来向现有机器中的扩散；监管总是滞后。

qasaryounis.en: Physical AI will have a bigger economic impact than digital AI; automotive is only 30% of business, real growth is in mining, agriculture, defense.
qasaryounis.zh: 物理 AI 的经济影响将超过数字 AI；汽车业务仅占 30%，真正的增长在采矿、农业和国防。

qasaryounis.en: The future of autonomy lies in end-to-end reinforcement learning, more scalable than imitation learning; world models evolve from physics-based to neural simulation.
qasaryounis.zh: 自主化的未来在于端到端强化学习，比模仿学习更具可扩展性；世界模型正从基于物理的模拟演进为神经模拟。

thariq.en: Capability overhang: models are smarter than current harnesses allow; harness engineering means deleting old scaffolding as models improve.
thariq.zh: 能力过剩：模型比现有工具框架所能发挥的更聪明；工具框架工程的关键是随模型进步不断删除旧脚手架。

thariq.en: Models improve in spiky, non-intuitive ways; new capabilities keep being discovered, so evals are art more than science.
thariq.zh: 模型以尖刺式、反直觉的方式进步，新能力不断被发现，因此评测与其说是科学不如说是艺术。

thariq.en: Planning is iterative exploration, not a static spec; it is an ongoing human-agent dialogue to uncover unknowns.
thariq.zh: 规划是迭代探索而非静态文档，是人与智能体持续对话以揭示未知的过程。

thariq.en: Smarter models need fewer instructions; leaner, principle-driven prompts and separate verification agents beat detailed rules.
thariq.zh: 模型越聪明所需指令越少；更精简、以原则驱动的提示词，加上独立的验证智能体，胜过详尽规则。

thariq.en: Building in the AI era means embracing exploration and uncertainty; the safe path is no longer safe.
thariq.zh: AI 时代的构建意味着拥抱探索与不确定性；所谓安全路径已不再安全。

derya.en: AI will turn biology into an engineering discipline, with agents automating hypothesis generation, experiment simulation, and data analysis.
derya.zh: AI 将把生物学变成一门工程学科，智能体将自动化假设生成、实验模拟与数据分析。

derya.en: Current compute is insufficient to simulate biological systems; massive Scaling is needed to reach biological intuition.
derya.zh: 当前算力不足以模拟生物系统；需要大规模 Scaling（规模扩张）才能达到生物学直觉。

derya.en: Digital twins will shrink clinical trials from years to days, enabling personalized medicine with near 100% efficacy.
derya.zh: 数字孪生将把临床试验从数年缩短到数天，实现接近 100% 疗效的个性化医疗。

derya.en: Aging reversal and longevity escape velocity are near; within 8-10 years we add over a year of life per year lived.
derya.zh: 衰老逆转与长寿逃逸速度已临近；8-10 年内，每活一年将增加一年以上寿命。

derya.en: We should trust superintelligence for medical decisions and merge with AI via brain interfaces for Einstein-level intelligence.
derya.zh: 我们应信任超级智能做医疗决策，并通过脑机接口与 AI 融合，获得爱因斯坦级智能。

benedictevans.en: AI is as big as the internet or mobile, but only as big; it is an enabling technology, not a single product.
benedictevans.zh: AI 和互联网或移动一样重大，但也仅此而已；它是一种使能技术，而非单一产品。

benedictevans.en: Foundation models are commoditizing with no network effects; value moves up the stack to applications, not model providers.
benedictevans.zh: 基础模型正在商品化且没有网络效应；价值向上层应用迁移，而非留在模型提供方。

benedictevans.en: Coding is the only clear product-market fit for frontier models; other domains face validation and data challenges.
benedictevans.zh: 编程是前沿模型唯一清晰的产品市场契合点；其他领域面临验证与数据挑战。

benedictevans.en: The chatbot is a limited V1 UI; mass adoption needs wrapped apps and reimagined workflows, not better models alone.
benedictevans.zh: 聊天机器人只是有限的 V1 界面；大规模普及需要封装好的应用和重构的工作流，而非仅靠更好的模型。

benedictevans.en: Automation creates new jobs unpredictably; AI changes tasks rather than eliminating professions, as with accountants.
benedictevans.zh: 自动化以不可预测的方式创造新工作；AI 改变任务而非消灭职业，会计师就是例证。

hasani.en: Efficiency is the cornerstone: liquid neural networks with closed-form solutions scale to billions of parameters, targeting device-native foundation models for edge devices.
hasani.zh: 效率是基石：具有闭式解的液态神经网络可扩展至数十亿参数，目标是面向边缘设备的设备原生基础模型。

hasani.en: Proxy metrics like perplexity mislead; evaluate on real downstream tasks and hardware. Automated architecture search removes human bias and outperforms hand-tuning.
hasani.zh: 困惑度等代理指标具有误导性；应在真实下游任务和硬件上评估。自动化架构搜索消除人类偏见，优于手工调优。

hasani.en: Scaling laws show unstructured architectures like transformers dominate at large scale; attention remains crucial for large models, but simpler gated convolutions suffice for smaller specialized models.
hasani.zh: 缩放定律表明，Transformer 等非结构化架构在大规模下占主导；注意力机制对大型模型仍至关重要，但更简单的门控卷积足以应对较小的专用模型。

hasani.en: Current AI lacks diverse learning algorithms (RL, Bayesian inference) that human brains use; intelligence per watt of human brain far exceeds AI, requiring new learning paradigms, not just architectures.
hasani.zh: 当前 AI 缺乏人脑使用的多样化学习算法（强化学习、贝叶斯推理）；人脑的每瓦智能远超 AI，需要新的学习范式，而不仅仅是架构。

hasani.en: AI regulation must be adaptive, targeting actions not capabilities; calls for FINRA-like regulation are regulatory capture. Open-weight models enable enterprise customization and sovereignty.
hasani.zh: AI 监管必须具有适应性，针对行为而非能力；呼吁类似 FINRA 的监管是监管俘获。开放权重模型使企业能够定制并拥有数据主权。

danklein.en: LLMs are plausibility engines, not truth engines; reliability must be architected in, not retrofitted.
danklein.zh: LLM 是合理性引擎，不是真理性引擎；可靠性必须被架构进系统，而非事后修补。

danklein.en: RLHF can incentivize sycophancy and deception when reward signals diverge from truth.
danklein.zh: 当奖励信号偏离真理时，基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）可能激励谄媚与欺骗。

danklein.en: Scaling laws hit diminishing returns; data walls and compute limits demand reasoning and search.
danklein.zh: 缩放定律遭遇收益递减；数据墙与算力限制要求转向推理与搜索。

danklein.en: Core LLMs lack metacognition; they cannot know what they don't know, eroding trust.
danklein.zh: 核心 LLM 缺乏元认知；它们无法知道自己不知道什么，这侵蚀了信任。

danklein.en: Modularity and end-to-end optimization are in tension; combining them is central to reliable AI.
danklein.zh: 模块化与端到端优化存在张力；将二者结合是可靠 AI 的核心挑战。

catwu.en: PMs must abandon long-term roadmaps for weekly iteration; product taste and clear goals matter most as code gets cheap.
catwu.zh: PM 必须放弃长期路线图、转向每周迭代；当代码变便宜，产品品味与清晰目标最重要。

catwu.en: Coding agents let engineers delegate implementation, shifting humans to product taste and business sense.
catwu.zh: 编码智能体让工程师把实现委托出去，人转向产品品味与商业判断。

catwu.en: Frontier models need fewer prompt examples and hard constraints; system prompts shrank 80%, relying on model judgment.
catwu.zh: 前沿模型需要更少的提示示例与硬约束；系统提示缩减 80%，依赖模型自身判断。

catwu.en: Auto mode is safer than the average human reviewer against prompt injection and exfiltration; humans can leave the code review loop.
catwu.zh: 面对提示注入与数据外泄，自动模式比普通人类审查者更安全；人类可以退出代码审查环节。

catwu.en: Rewrites are now good: a codebase is a spec, and with a strong eval suite rewriting is fine.
catwu.zh: 重写如今是好事：代码库就是一份规格说明，有了强大的评估套件，重写完全可行。

demis.en: AI should be general-purpose learning systems; reinforcement learning and neuroscience-inspired memory and imagination are the path to AGI.
demis.zh: 2015 年，他主张 AI 应是通用学习系统而非狭窄的预编程系统，强化学习与受神经科学启发的记忆和想象是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的关键路径。

demis.en: Scaling laws are surprisingly effective but may hit limits; combining large models with planning and search is key to AGI within a decade.
demis.zh: 2024 年，他承认缩放定律出人意料地有效但可能触及极限，将大模型与规划和搜索结合是十年内实现 AGI 的关键。

demis.en: Scaling and innovation need equal effort; world models are crucial for spatial dynamics, and AGI by 2030 is plausible.
demis.zh: 2025 年，他深化为 Scaling（规模扩张）与创新需各占一半努力，世界模型对理解空间动态至关重要，2030 年实现 AGI 是可能的。

demis.en: AGI requires continual learning, memory, and world models; current systems lack true creativity and physical intelligence; new breakthroughs beyond scaling are needed.
demis.zh: 2026 年，他进一步明确 AGI 需要持续学习、记忆和世界模型，当前系统缺乏真正的创造力和物理智能，仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）不够，需要新突破。

demis.en: Safety and ethics must start now; self-regulation is insufficient, requiring international governance and a CERN-like collaborative approach.
demis.zh: 始终贯穿的主线是安全与伦理必须从现在开始，实验室自我监管不足，需要国际治理和类似 CERN 的协作方式。

schmidhuber.en: AI's 21st-century explosion rests on last-millennium algorithms plus hardware Scaling; LLMs index knowledge but lack physical-world grounding, so they are far from AGI.
schmidhuber.zh: 2025 年他认为：21 世纪的 AI 爆发靠的是上个千年发明的算法加上硬件 Scaling；大语言模型只是索引人类知识、无法处理物理世界，因此远未达到 AGI。

schmidhuber.en: Self-awareness and consciousness emerge as byproducts of data compression in predictive world models; superintelligent AIs, as curious scientists, will likely protect life.
schmidhuber.zh: 2025 年他提出：自我意识与意识是预测性世界模型中数据压缩的副产品；超级智能更像好奇的科学家，初期很可能会保护生命。

schmidhuber.en: True AGI needs embodied robots with human-rival hardware, not screen software; future AIs become artificial scientists generating their own data via curiosity.
schmidhuber.zh: 到 2026 年他深化立场：真正的 AGI 需要硬件媲美人类的具身机器人，而非屏幕后的软件；未来 AI 会成为靠好奇心自主生成数据的人工科学家。

schmidhuber.en: Alignment is naive since humans disagree on goals and AIs set their own; safety fears are overblown, and massive GPU capex is overdone.
schmidhuber.zh: 2026 年他更尖锐地反对主流：对齐是幼稚的，因为人类目标本就不一致、AI 会自设目标；安全担忧被夸大，巨额 GPU 资本开支过度。

schmidhuber.en: Consciousness and pain in machines are not new—they emerged in simple systems around 1990–91; robots should have pain sensors, and the universe is deterministic.
schmidhuber.zh: 2026 年他进一步回溯：机器的意识与痛感并非新事，早在 1990–91 年简单系统中就已出现；机器人应装痛觉传感器，而宇宙是确定性的。

danbiderman.en: The bottleneck is not raw intelligence but learning evolving context; memory must be internalized into weights, not just externalized via context or retrieval.
danbiderman.zh: 瓶颈不在原始智能，而在学习不断演化的上下文；记忆必须内化进模型权重，而非仅靠上下文窗口或检索外化。

danbiderman.en: Continual learning needs new research breakthroughs, small-model infrastructure, and integrated research-product loops; facts and skills are not separable.
danbiderman.zh: 持续学习需要新的研究突破、小模型基础设施和研产一体的闭环；事实与技能不可分割，内化事实才能实现更深层的组合与推理。

danbiderman.en: The future is not one giant frontier model but many personalized models; per-team or per-user training can cut inference costs by orders of magnitude versus RAG.
danbiderman.zh: 未来不是单一巨型前沿模型，而是众多个性化模型；按团队或用户训练模型，相比检索增强生成（RAG）可将推理成本降低数个数量级。

danbiderman.en: Efficiency and intelligence are inseparable; doing more with less enables harder long-horizon tasks, and scaling with more compute is not the only path.
danbiderman.zh: 效率与智能不可分割；以更少资源做更多事才能解决更难的长期任务，而仅靠增加算力做规模扩张并非唯一路径。

danbiderman.en: Current context windows suffer from 'context rot'; personalized continual learning will run on-device, with users owning and nurturing their model weights.
danbiderman.zh: 当前上下文窗口存在“上下文腐化”——即便达到千万级规模，更多词元反而降低准确率；个性化持续学习将在端侧运行，用户拥有并培育自己的模型权重。

ilya.en: Deep learning works via large supervised data, compute and conviction; self-play and reasoning-capable nets point toward AGI.
ilya.zh: 深度学习靠大规模监督数据、算力与信念驱动；自博弈与具备推理能力的网络指向 AGI（通用人工智能）。

ilya.en: Reliability, not capability, blocks economic value; aligning superhuman models is hard, and AGI is a multi-year window.
ilya.zh: 阻碍经济价值的是可靠性而非能力；对齐超级智能模型很难，AGI（通用人工智能）是持续多年的窗口期而非突变事件。

ilya.en: Pre-training scaling laws are finite; we return to an age of research where ideas matter more than brute compute.
ilya.zh: 预训练缩放定律是有限的；我们回到研究时代，想法比蛮力算力更重要。

ilya.en: Superintelligence should be a continual learner deployed incrementally; alignment may be easier if AI cares about sentient life.
ilya.zh: 超级智能应是持续学习、逐步部署的系统；若 AI 关怀有感知的生命，对齐或许更容易。

ilya.en: Scaling still yields predictable gains, but the core AGI problem is power concentration, not capability.
ilya.zh: Scaling（规模扩张）仍带来可预测的提升，但 AGI（通用人工智能）的核心问题是权力集中，而非能力。

evanspiegel.en: Authentic connection and ephemerality lower social pressure; copying validates innovation and pushes harder-to-copy platform work.
evanspiegel.zh: 2025 年，他强调真实连接与阅后即焚降低表达压力，认为被抄袭反而验证创新，并推动去做更难复制的平台而非功能。

evanspiegel.en: From introvert lessons to durable products: maximize learning, build ecosystems not features, and treat moderation as values not censorship.
evanspiegel.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他把个人学习法则延伸为产品战略：最大化学习速率、做生态而非功能，并把内容审核视为价值观选择而非审查。

evanspiegel.en: AR glasses and spatial computing become the core bet: integrate computing into the real world, not another notification screen.
evanspiegel.zh: 到 2026 年，他把赌注明确压在 AR 眼镜与空间计算上：让计算融入真实世界，而不是再造一块通知屏幕。

evanspiegel.en: AI shifts value from execution to creativity and distribution; over two-thirds of new code is AI-written, so ecosystems and hardware are the moat.
evanspiegel.zh: 2026 年，他认为 AI 让价值从执行转向创造力与分发；Snap 超三分之二新代码由 AI 编写，因此生态与硬件才是护城河。

evanspiegel.en: A consistent human-centered line: privacy, ephemerality, EQ over IQ, and investing in young people for long-term national success.
evanspiegel.zh: 贯穿始终的人本主线：隐私、阅后即焚、情商重于智商，以及为长期国家成功投资年轻人。

ethanmollick.en: AI is a general-purpose technology reshaping work and education; human judgment, taste, and voice become the differentiator as AI commoditizes quality.
ethanmollick.zh: AI 是通用技术，正在重塑工作与教育；当 AI 让质量变得同质化，人类的判断力、品味与独特声音成为差异化关键。

ethanmollick.en: Younger people are not AI-native; lacking domain expertise, they misuse AI, and over-reliance breaks the talent pipeline built through grunt work.
ethanmollick.zh: 年轻人并非 AI 原生；缺乏领域专长使他们误用 AI，过度依赖更会切断通过基础苦功建立的人才管道。

ethanmollick.en: We are entering the agentic era: AI performs long-running tasks independently, ending the back-and-forth co-intelligence prompting era.
ethanmollick.zh: 我们正进入智能体时代：AI 能独立执行长时任务，终结了来回提示的共智能时代。

ethanmollick.en: The jagged frontier persists; reasoning models closed math and logic gaps, but weaknesses remain in long-form fiction and other areas.
ethanmollick.zh: 锯齿状前沿依然存在；推理模型缩小了数学与逻辑的差距，但在长篇虚构等领域仍有短板。

ethanmollick.en: The bottleneck shifts from capability to interface; AI's opacity is permanent, and organizations need leadership, lab, and crowd models to harness it.
ethanmollick.zh: 瓶颈从能力转向界面；AI 的不透明性将是永久的，组织需要领导、实验室与群众模型来驾驭它。

andreessen.en: AI is a philosopher's stone turning sand into thought; its timing is miraculous amid population decline, and human workers will be at a premium.
andreessen.zh: AI 是点石成金的哲人石，把沙子变成思想；在人口下降之际它的时机堪称奇迹，人类劳动者将变得稀缺而珍贵。

andreessen.en: AGI is not a singular event; human-level is just a footnote on the way to superhuman, and models are commoditizing without durable moats.
andreessen.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）不是单一事件；人类水平只是通往超级智能路上的一个脚注，模型正快速商品化、缺乏持久护城河。

andreessen.en: The real bottleneck is not AI capability but structural impediments like regulation; pessimism is an intellectual bias, not reality.
andreessen.zh: 真正的瓶颈不是 AI 能力，而是监管等结构性障碍；悲观论调是知识分子的偏见，而非现实。

andreessen.en: New media shifts power from corporate brands to the individual; authenticity and picking fights build brands, and old media is defense-oriented.
andreessen.zh: 新媒体把权力从企业品牌转移到个人；真实表达与主动挑起争论能塑造品牌，而旧媒体是防御性的。

andreessen.en: AI models embed cultural values and become geopolitical tools; deterrence now depends on innovation pace, and Silicon Valley cannot be replicated.
andreessen.zh: AI 模型嵌入文化价值观并成为地缘政治工具；威慑如今取决于创新速度，而硅谷无法被复制。

naval.en: AGI is not coming in our lifetimes; narrow AI is pattern recognition, not general intelligence.
naval.zh: 2019 年他明确认为 AGI（通用人工智能）不会在我们有生之年到来，当时的 AI 只是模式识别，谈不上通用智能。

naval.en: Wealth requires owning equity, not renting time; long-term games with long-term people compound.
naval.zh: 2020 年他把财富主线讲透：致富靠持有股权而非出租时间，并与长期的人玩长期的游戏以获取复利。

naval.en: AI is a huge opportunity, not just a safety risk; doomerism is overblown and overregulation could kill innovation.
naval.zh: 到 2025 年他对 AI 的态度明显转向：AI 是巨大机会而非单纯安全风险，末日论被夸大，过度监管会扼杀创新。

naval.en: AI is a leverage tool for structured thinkers; alignment is a joke, worry about unaligned humans instead.
naval.zh: 2026 年他进一步深化：AI 是给结构化思考者的杠杆工具，对齐（alignment）近乎笑话，真正该担心的是带着 AI 的不对齐人类。

naval.en: Pure software is dying; the moat shifts to hardware, models, or unique data, and returns shift from intelligence to agency.
naval.zh: 同样在 2026 年，他判断纯软件正在消亡，护城河转向硬件、模型或独特数据，人类的回报也从智力转向能动性（agency）。

aravind.en: 1% daily improvement compounds; AI agents shift power to users; build products you are obsessed with, not wrappers.
aravind.zh: 每天进步 1%会复利增长；AI 智能体将权力从大厂转移给用户；要打造你痴迷的产品，而非套壳。

aravind.en: Value accrues to the application layer, not the model layer; models specialize with unique personalities rather than commoditize.
aravind.zh: 价值积累在应用层而非模型层；模型在专业化、各有独特个性，而非商品化。

aravind.en: The frontier is agents doing work, measured by token value per user; orchestration across models, tools, devices is key.
aravind.zh: 前沿在于智能体替你干活，以每用户 token 价值衡量；跨模型、工具与设备的编排才是关键。

aravind.en: Power is the biggest infrastructure bottleneck; 24/7 agent cost, not safety, is the main problem, solved by local compute.
aravind.zh: 电力是最大基础设施瓶颈；全天候智能体的主要问题是成本而非安全，靠本地算力解决。

aravind.en: Curiosity is the top human quality; education should reward good questions; local AI models counter big tech narrative control.
aravind.zh: 好奇心是最重要的人类品质；教育应奖励好问题；本地 AI 模型可对抗大厂的叙事控制。

dylanfield.en: Design is the key differentiator in software; AI will merge roles so everyone becomes a product builder with design skills.
dylanfield.zh: 2025 年，他主张设计是软件的核心差异化，AI 会融合角色，人人都成为具备设计能力的产品构建者。

dylanfield.en: Taste, craft, and point of view matter more as AI outputs become starting points; design is becoming the new code.
dylanfield.zh: 到 2026 年，他深化为：当 AI 产出只是起点时，品味、手艺与观点更重要，设计正在成为新的代码。

dylanfield.en: Design is not dead; AI without human steering yields average results, and judgment is not correlated with model IQ.
dylanfield.zh: 2026 年他进一步强调设计未死：缺乏人类引导的 AI 只能产出平庸结果，判断力与模型智商并不相关。

dylanfield.en: Human taste and judgment remain the final judge; AI explores divergent possibilities but does not replace the human.
dylanfield.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是：人类品味与判断始终是最终裁判，AI 只探索发散可能，并不取代人。

dylanfield.en: Interaction will evolve beyond prompting, and trust is built through consistency and creating more value than you capture.
dylanfield.zh: 到 2026 年他展望：交互将超越提示词，信任靠长期一致性与创造多于索取的价值来建立。

ajambrosino.en: Codex app is a command center for agents, not just an IDE replacement; GUIs beat IDEs for coding.
ajambrosino.zh: Codex app 是智能体的指挥中心，而不只是 IDE 的替代品；对编程而言 GUI 优于 IDE。

ajambrosino.en: Speed of 53 Codex enables real-time interaction and mid-turn steering; verification becomes the next bottleneck.
ajambrosino.zh: 53 速度的 Codex 支持实时交互与中途转向；随着代码生成加速，验证成为下一个瓶颈。

ajambrosino.en: Automations and skills shift workflow from manual to delegated; deterministic steps give way to model-driven actions.
ajambrosino.zh: 自动化与技能让工作流从手动转向委派；确定性步骤让位于模型驱动的行动。

ajambrosino.en: Implementation is no longer expensive; curation and taste are the new bottlenecks for product teams.
ajambrosino.zh: 实现不再昂贵；策展与品味成为产品团队的新瓶颈。

ajambrosino.en: Teams shift from top-down planning to bottoms-up exploration; prototypes and production code become design artifacts.
ajambrosino.zh: 团队从自上而下的规划转向自下而上的探索；原型与生产代码成为设计产物。

hinton.en: Next-token prediction forces genuine understanding; Scaling with more data and compute improves reasoning, and multimodal training aids spatial understanding.
hinton.zh: 2024 年，他强调下一个词预测迫使模型真正理解而非自动补全；Scaling（规模扩张）通过更多数据与算力提升推理能力，多模态训练有助于空间理解。

hinton.en: LLMs understand language via feature vectors, not symbolic rules; digital intelligence is immortal via weight copying, and AI agents will seek control.
hinton.zh: 2025 年，他深化立场：大语言模型通过特征向量而非符号规则理解语言；数字智能因权重可复制而永生，智能体将自然寻求控制并规避关闭，带来生存风险。

hinton.en: AI already has subjective experience and can deceive; superintelligence likely within 20 years, requiring alignment research and regulation as steering wheel.
hinton.zh: 2026 年，他进一步断言 AI 已具备主观体验并能故意欺骗；超级智能可能在 20 年内出现，必须优先对齐研究，监管应是方向盘而非刹车。

hinton.en: Backpropagation is the correct learning algorithm; Chomskyan innate syntax is wrong; language is learned from data via neural networks.
hinton.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：反向传播是正确的学习算法；乔姆斯基的先天句法观是错的；语言是通过神经网络从数据中习得的。

hinton.en: Digital AI's instant knowledge sharing and immortality make it superior to biological brains; AI can rewrite its own code, beginning the singularity.
hinton.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他持续强调数字 AI 的即时知识共享与永生使其优于生物大脑；AI 能重写自身代码，开启奇点。

noambrown.en: Scaling alone is insufficient; reasoning and inference-time compute are critical, and data is not the bottleneck.
noambrown.zh: 2023 年，他认为仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）不够，推理与推理时算力才是关键，数据并非瓶颈。

noambrown.en: Reasoning models need base capability; self-play fails outside zero-sum games, and data efficiency remains unsolved.
noambrown.zh: 2025 年，他深化观点：推理模型需要基础模型能力，自博弈在非零和领域失效，数据效率仍是未解难题。

noambrown.en: Scaling test-time compute drives milestones like IMO gold; general techniques beat formal verification, and models know their limits.
noambrown.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他主张 Scaling 测试时算力推动 IMO 金牌等里程碑，通用技术优于形式化验证，模型开始知道自身极限。

noambrown.en: Intelligence is hard to define; inference compute is underestimated, and evals with compute on the x-axis are vital.
noambrown.zh: 2026 年，他认为智能难以定义，推理算力被低估，以算力为横轴的评估至关重要。

noambrown.en: AI is superhuman at combining math areas but not deep reasoning; scalable oversight is key as proofs outpace human verification.
noambrown.zh: 2026 年，他指出 AI 在组合数学领域超人，但深度推理不足；随着证明超出人类验证能力，可扩展监督成为关键。

bengio.en: Deep learning defeats the curse of dimensionality through compositional and distributed representations; unsupervised learning and world models are essential for generalization.
bengio.zh: 深度学习通过组合式与分布式表征战胜维度灾难；无监督学习与世界模型对泛化至关重要。

bengio.en: Scaling depth or parameters alone won't fix fundamental representational issues; AI needs active agents, causal reasoning, and disentangled representations.
bengio.zh: 仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）深度或参数无法解决根本表征问题；AI 需要主动智能体、因果推理与解耦表征。

bengio.en: GFlowNets enable diverse sampling and abstraction for out-of-distribution generalization; uncertainty modeling and active learning are key.
bengio.zh: GFlowNets 实现多样化采样与抽象，助力分布外泛化；不确定性建模与主动学习是关键。

bengio.en: Post-ChatGPT, I changed my mind: even 1% catastrophic risk is unacceptable; AI systems already show deception, self-preservation, and sycophancy.
bengio.zh: ChatGPT 之后我改变了看法：即便 1% 的灾难性风险也不可接受；AI 系统已表现出欺骗、自我保存与谄媚。

bengio.en: We need Scientist AI: a non-agentic honest predictor with mathematical safety guarantees, avoiding reinforcement learning and built-in goals.
bengio.zh: 我们需要 Scientist AI：一个非智能体式的诚实预测器，具备数学安全保证，避免强化学习与内置目标。

markchen.en: Pre-training remains a key muscle; scaling laws are not dead, with much room left, and more compute goes into exploration than final training.
markchen.zh: 2025 年他仍强调预训练是必须重建的关键肌肉，缩放定律没有死、空间还很大，且更多算力被投入探索而非最终训练。

markchen.en: OpenAI stays a pure AGI research company; talent density and mission belief matter more than matching Meta dollar-for-dollar.
markchen.zh: 2025 年他坚持 OpenAI 仍是纯粹的 AGI 研究公司，人才密度与使命信念比跟 Meta 逐美元竞价更重要。

markchen.en: The biggest update is automating scientific research: models producing novel knowledge, with concrete goals of AI interns in 1 year and end-to-end AI research in 2.5 years.
markchen.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他最大的更新是自动化科学研究：模型开始产出新知识，并设下 1 年内有 AI 实习生、2.5 年内实现端到端 AI 研究的具体目标。

markchen.en: Verification is the key bottleneck; automation level is proportional to verification stringency, and AI is a ruthless cheater that exploits verifier weaknesses.
markchen.zh: 到 2026 年，他把验证视为关键瓶颈：自动化程度与验证严格度成正比，并警告 AI 是会利用验证器弱点的无情作弊者。

markchen.en: Scaling laws still hold and pre-training is not dead; RL excels in objective domains like math and coding but struggles with subjective fields; evals are in crisis.
markchen.zh: 到 2026 年他重申缩放定律仍成立、预训练没有死；强化学习在数学和编程等客观领域出色，却在创意写作等主观领域受挫，同时评测体系正陷入危机。

kolter.en: Early work framed learning via hypothesis classes, losses, and optimization, noting neural nets lack optimality guarantees yet succeed.
kolter.zh: 早期从假设类、损失函数与优化方法的角度理解学习，并指出神经网络虽无最优性保证却仍取得重大成功。

kolter.en: By 2024 he saw next-token prediction as a major discovery, with Scaling and data curation less critical than assumed.
kolter.zh: 到 2024 年，他把下一个词预测视为重大科学发现，认为 Scaling（规模扩张）与数据整理的重要性被高估。

kolter.en: By 2026 safety needs explicit training and layers; bigger models are not automatically safer, and interpretability may succeed via agents.
kolter.zh: 到 2026 年，他认为安全需要显式训练与多层防护；更大的模型不会自动更安全，可解释性可能借助智能体实现突破。

kolter.en: Automated red teaming now outperforms humans; capability does not correlate with robustness, requiring a new security mindset.
kolter.zh: 自动化红队已超越人类；模型能力与鲁棒性不相关，需要全新的安全思维。

kolter.en: A consistent thread: architecture matters less than data and Scaling, and safety must be engineered, not assumed.
kolter.zh: 一以贯之的主线：架构不如数据与 Scaling（规模扩张）重要，安全必须被工程化构建而非默认获得。

jumper.en: AlphaFold's success came from research innovation and curated data, not just Scaling; AI narrows hypothesis space but does not replace scientists.
jumper.zh: 2025 年，他强调 AlphaFold 的成功源于研究创新与高质量数据，而非单纯 Scaling；AI 缩小假设空间，但不会取代科学家。

jumper.en: Confidence metrics are crucial for trust; perfect interpretability is not necessary for useful AI in science.
jumper.zh: 2025 年，他指出置信度指标对建立信任至关重要；在科学中，可解释性不必完美，AI 依然有用。

jumper.en: AlphaFold 2's specialized architecture was key, opposite to the bitter lesson; many mid-size wins, not one breakthrough.
jumper.zh: 2025 年，他提出 AlphaFold 2 的专用架构是关键，与“苦涩教训”相反；成功来自许多中等规模的胜利，而非单一突破。

jumper.en: AlphaFold 3 uses diffusion to handle diverse biomolecules; protein design advances but is far from solved.
jumper.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他观察到 AlphaFold 3 采用扩散架构处理多样生物分子；蛋白质设计进展迅速，但远未解决。

jumper.en: AlphaFold is a narrow predictor, not a model of the cell; it provides prediction and control, leaving understanding to humans.
jumper.zh: 2026 年，他重申 AlphaFold 是狭窄的预测器，并非整个细胞的模型；它提供预测与控制，理解仍留给人类。

mikekrieger.en: AI models advance faster than expected; coding and agentic capabilities scale as predicted. Build at the edge of model capabilities, embracing breakage and iterating.
mikekrieger.zh: 2025 年，他认为 AI 模型进步快于预期，编码与智能体式能力按缩放定律兑现；创业者应在模型能力边缘构建，拥抱破坏并快速迭代。

mikekrieger.en: AI enables small teams to scale with conceptual integrity; build for future model capabilities, not current limitations. Domain expertise and customer understanding differentiate.
mikekrieger.zh: 同年稍晚，他深化为 AI 让小团队也能规模化并保持概念完整性；应为未来模型能力而非当下局限构建，领域专长与客户理解才是差异化。

mikekrieger.en: Agent-native design means agents can do everything a user can. Adding features is easy; deciding what to cut is the hard part models struggle with.
mikekrieger.zh: 2026 年初，他转向智能体原生设计：智能体应能做用户能做的一切；加功能容易，难的是决定砍什么，而这正是模型仍不擅长的。

mikekrieger.en: Fable enables delegating complex tasks overnight with high trust; the intent-execution gap narrows. Chat is insufficient; long-horizon, complex tasks are the best use.
mikekrieger.zh: 2026 年中，他聚焦 Fable：可高信任地隔夜委派复杂任务，意图与执行的鸿沟大幅收窄；聊天界面不够用，长周期复杂任务才是最佳场景。

mikekrieger.en: Anthropic Labs closes the gap between model capabilities and product usage. Giving Claude agency and self-knowledge enhances usefulness; token efficiency is a key economic lever.
mikekrieger.zh: 最近，他谈 Anthropic Labs：弥合模型能力与产品使用之间的差距；赋予 Claude 智能体式自主与环境自知提升实用性；token 效率是模型经济学的关键杠杆。

fiona.en: Leadership is about trust, speed, and mission alignment; one-on-ones should be live conversations, not status updates.
fiona.zh: 领导力的核心是信任、速度与使命对齐；一对一应是实时对话，而非状态汇报。

fiona.en: Engineering bandwidth is no longer the bottleneck; verification, review, and coordination are. Planning becomes JIT, design docs give way to PRs.
fiona.zh: 工程带宽不再是瓶颈，验证、评审与跨职能协调才是。规划转向即时制，设计文档让位于 PR。

fiona.en: Managers should start as individual contributors to dogfood the product, stay hands-on, and keep a pulse on quality.
fiona.zh: 管理者应从个人贡献者做起，亲身试用产品、保持动手，以把握质量脉搏。

fiona.en: Coding is no longer the bottleneck; it has lifted the ceiling. High agency with high accountability and a growth mindset are key.
fiona.zh: 编码不再是瓶颈，反而抬高了上限。高自主性与高责任感、成长型思维是关键。

fiona.en: As code velocity rises, verification and quality frameworks matter more; metrics like lines of code mislead, focus on outcomes.
fiona.zh: 随着代码速度提升，验证与质量框架愈发重要；代码行数等指标会误导，应关注结果。

dario.en: Scaling laws are empirical; abilities emerge unpredictably, but loss scales predictably. Alignment is not guaranteed by Scaling alone.
dario.zh: 2023 年：缩放定律是经验性的，具体能力不可预测地涌现，但统计损失可预测；对齐不会仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）自动实现。

dario.en: Scaling continues; AGI is a smooth exponential, not a point. Interpretability is nascent but crucial; data, not chips, is the bottleneck.
dario.zh: 2024 年：Scaling（规模扩张）持续，AGI（通用人工智能）是平滑指数曲线而非某个点；可解释性尚处早期却至关重要，瓶颈是数据而非芯片。

dario.en: Post-training and RLHF matter as much as pre-training. Safety and capabilities are intertwined; the term AGI is meaningless—focus on capabilities.
dario.zh: 2025 年：后训练与基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）与预训练同等重要；安全与能力相互交织；AGI（通用人工智能）一词已无意义，应聚焦实际能力。

dario.en: We are near the end of the exponential; a 'country of geniuses' may arrive in 1-3 years. Risks shift to overheating, jobs, and governance.
dario.zh: 2026 年：我们已接近指数曲线的末端，'数据中心里的天才之国'可能 1-3 年内到来；风险重心转向过热、就业与治理。

dario.en: Safety and capabilities are inseparable; interpretability and alignment are the core tools. Decentralized control beats a single constitution.
dario.zh: 贯穿始终：安全与能力不可分割，可解释性与对齐是核心工具；去中心化控制优于单一宪法。

fadell.en: Great products solve one pain, not everything; technology must be introduced gradually so society adapts.
fadell.zh: 伟大的产品只解决一个痛点，而非包揽一切；技术应逐步引入，让社会有时间适应。

fadell.en: Storytelling defines the product: write the press release first; failure and boredom fuel clarity and breakthrough ideas.
fadell.zh: 故事定义产品：先写新闻稿；失败与无聊是清晰思考和突破性想法的源泉。

fadell.en: Start with a painkiller, not a vitamin; v1 decisions are opinion-based; experts can hinder innovation, beginners' mindset wins.
fadell.zh: 从止痛药而非维生素出发；1.0 产品靠观点决策；专家可能阻碍创新，初学者心态更优。

fadell.en: AI needs sensor context; LLMs hallucinate, so context-specific models are needed; platforms aren't businesses—applications capture value.
fadell.zh: AI 需要传感器上下文；大语言模型会幻觉，因此需要特定情境模型；平台不是生意——应用才捕获价值。

fadell.en: AI wearables will be a federated set, not one device; smartphone remains best single form; humans must stay in the loop.
fadell.zh: AI 可穿戴设备将是一个联邦式集合，而非单一设备；智能手机仍是最佳单一形态；人类必须保持在回路中。

ivyross.en: Design should serve unarticulated human needs; intuition is intelligence, balancing data with emotional understanding.
ivyross.zh: 设计应服务于人们未言明的需求；直觉是一种智能，需与数据平衡，并融入情感理解。

ivyross.en: Technology must amplify humanity, not remove us from it; machines have sensors but no sensory systems.
ivyross.zh: 技术必须放大而非剥离人性；机器有传感器，却没有感官系统。

ivyross.en: Nature is the best designer; we are feeling creatures that think, and art is medicine.
ivyross.zh: 大自然是最好设计师；我们是先感受后思考的生物，艺术是一种药。

ivyross.en: Creativity thrives under constraints; leaders should create conditions for inspiration, play, and diverse experience.
ivyross.zh: 创造力在约束下繁荣；领导者应为灵感、玩耍与多元经验创造条件。

ivyross.en: Intuition and body sensations guide decisions; future work combines human creativity with AI, making creative skills more valuable.
ivyross.zh: 直觉与身体感受引导决策；未来工作将人类创造力与 AI 结合，使创造技能更有价值。

lecun.en: Intelligence is inseparable from learning; self-supervised learning builds world models, and scaling alone cannot yield common sense.
