lecun.zh: 2019 年他主张智能离不开学习，自监督学习是构建世界模型的关键，仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）无法获得常识。

lecun.en: Self-supervised learning is the dark matter of intelligence; intelligence is prediction, and text alone is insufficient for AGI.
lecun.zh: 2022 年他深化为自监督学习是智能的暗物质，智能本质是预测，仅靠文本不足以实现 AGI（通用人工智能）。

lecun.en: Autoregressive LLMs cannot reach human-level intelligence; JEPA and open source are essential, and AGI will be gradual.
lecun.zh: 2024 年他明确自回归 LLM 无法达到人类水平智能，JEPA 与开源至关重要，AGI 将是渐进过程。

lecun.en: LLMs are less intelligent than a house cat; world models enabling reasoning and planning are the next breakthrough.
lecun.zh: 2025 年他断言 LLM 不如家猫聪明，能实现推理与规划的世界模型才是下一个突破。

lecun.en: LLMs are a dead end; objective-driven world models in abstract representation space are the path, with open research and a robotics decade ahead.
lecun.zh: 2026 年他判定 LLM 是死胡同，在抽象表征空间中的目标驱动世界模型才是出路，并强调开放研究与机器人十年。

gustav.en: LLMs are deterministic next-token predictors; intelligence is compression, and values are inserted via RLHF, not inherent.
gustav.zh: 2023 年，他把大语言模型理解为确定性的下一个词预测器：智能即压缩，模型价值观并非内生，而是通过基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）由一小群人植入。

gustav.en: The internet shifts from curation to recommendation to generation, so products must be rebuilt around generative, fault-tolerant interfaces.
gustav.zh: 2023 年，他判断互联网正从策展走向推荐、再走向生成，因此产品必须围绕生成式、容错的界面重新设计。

gustav.en: AI is a macro shift like the smartphone; real gains come from rebuilding infrastructure, and inference cost will force new business models.
gustav.zh: 2025 年，他把 AI 视为类似智能手机的宏观变迁：真正收益来自重建基础设施，而推理的边际成本将倒逼商业模式改变。

gustav.en: Generative AI makes products conversational and symmetric, giving users plain-English control over algorithms rather than more addiction.
gustav.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他深化为：生成式 AI 让产品变得对话式、双向对称，把算法的控制权用大白话交还用户，而非让人更上瘾。

gustav.en: Strong opinions loosely held: believe fully until data says no; good explanations, not pattern recognition, drive innovation.
gustav.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：强烈信念但随时可弃——数据说不前坚信不疑；推动创新的是难以变通的好解释，而非模式识别。

satya.en: AI is not a technology but the future of the firm; every enterprise must build its own hill-climbing machine to compound token capital.
satya.zh: AI 不是一项技术，而是企业的未来；每家企业都必须构建自己的爬坡机器，以复利式积累 token 资本。

satya.en: The true eval is when people do unique things they value, not benchmark scores; private evals may be the biggest IP.
satya.zh: 真正的评估是人们做自己看重的独特事情，而非基准分数；私有评估可能是最大的知识产权。

satya.en: Don't use frontier models for non-frontier problems; token efficiency matters, and CEOs must understand token capital.
satya.zh: 不要用前沿模型解决非前沿问题；token 效率至关重要，CEO 必须理解 token 资本。

satya.en: Security, containment, manageability, and observability are critical for agent deployment; the biggest risk is tacit knowledge leaking.
satya.zh: 安全、遏制、可管理性和可观测性对智能体部署至关重要；最大的风险是隐性知识泄露。

satya.en: The AI industry has lost social permission due to fear-mongering; sovereign AI is best achieved by enabling companies to hill-climb.
satya.zh: AI 行业因散布恐惧而失去了社会许可；主权 AI 最好通过赋能企业爬坡来实现。

suleyman.en: Compute scaling, not just algorithms, drives predictable AI progress; Google held ChatGPT-level tech in 2020 but stayed conservative.
suleyman.zh: 2023 年他强调：推动 AI 进步的是算力规模扩张而非单纯算法，进展比人们想的更可预测；谷歌早在 2020 年就握有 ChatGPT 级技术，却因保守而未发布。

suleyman.en: Human-level AI arrives in 3-5 years; containment is hard as models shrink, yet existential risk is infinitesimally small.
suleyman.zh: 2024 年他判断 3-5 年内 AI 将在多任务上达到人类水平；随着模型变小变便宜，遏制极难，但存在性风险微乎其微，重心应放在近期能力。

suleyman.en: Near-term danger is anthropomorphism—attributing consciousness to AI; companions should set boundaries, not be sycophantic.
suleyman.zh: 2025 年他把近期最大危险转向拟人化——人们把意识归给 AI；AI 伴侣应设定边界、敢于反驳，而非一味迎合。

suleyman.en: Superintelligence must be humanist and subordinate to humans; containment precedes alignment, with red lines on self-improvement.
suleyman.zh: 2025 至 2026 年他深化为：超级智能必须是人文主义的、从属于人类；遏制先于对齐，并对自主设定目标与自我改进划红线。

suleyman.en: Frontier self-sufficiency via gigawatt compute; white-collar tasks automated in 12-18 months, but tasks not whole jobs.
suleyman.zh: 2026 年他主张以吉瓦级算力实现前沿模型自给；白领任务将在 12-18 个月内被自动化，但被替代的是任务而非整个职业。

murati.en: Scaling laws and one large model were not obvious bets; real-world deployment is essential for learning and alignment.
murati.zh: 2023 年她回顾早期：缩放定律与押注单一大型模型并非显而易见；真实世界部署对学习与对齐至关重要。

murati.en: AGI will change every aspect of life, so safety work must be done in public, not behind closed doors.
murati.zh: 2023 年她强调：AGI（通用人工智能）将改变生活每个方面，因此安全工作必须在公开环境中进行，而非闭门造车。

murati.en: A consistent thread: keep humans in the loop and iterate with public feedback to align AI with intent and values.
murati.zh: 从 2023 到 2026 一以贯之的主线：让人类保持在回路中，并通过公开反馈迭代，使 AI 与意图和价值观对齐。

murati.en: Shift to interaction models for real-time, high-bandwidth collaboration, moving beyond turn-based human-AI exchange.
murati.zh: 到 2026 年转向交互模型：实现实时、高带宽的人机协作，超越回合制的人机交互。

murati.en: Deepened focus on institutional design, transparency, and checks and balances over individual character; durable progress needs humans in the loop.
murati.zh: 2026 年深化：更重视制度设计、透明度与制衡，而非个人品格；持久进步需要人类保持在回路中。

carinahong.en: Scaling informal models alone cannot reach superintelligence in math; formal verification is essential for sound, scalable reasoning.
carinahong.zh: 仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）非形式化模型无法在数学上通向超级智能；形式化验证对可靠且可扩展的推理不可或缺。

carinahong.en: Verified generation yields performance gains and sample efficiency, reframing verification as scaling brilliance rather than just error elimination.
carinahong.zh: 经过验证的生成带来性能提升与样本效率，把验证重新定义为 Scaling（规模扩张）卓越性，而不仅是消除错误。

carinahong.en: Auto-formalization is harder than proving; correctly formalizing statements without solutions is the core bottleneck.
carinahong.zh: 自动形式化比证明更难；在没有解的情况下正确形式化陈述才是核心瓶颈。

carinahong.en: A self-improving reasoning engine combines prover, conjecturer, and knowledge base, weaving formal and informal reasoning together.
carinahong.zh: 自改进推理引擎结合证明器、猜想器与知识库，将形式化与非形式化推理编织在一起。

carinahong.en: Human taste and intuition remain crucial even with superhuman AI proving theorems; startup culture should preserve hunger and discomfort.
carinahong.zh: 即便 AI 能证明定理超越人类，人类的品味与直觉依然关键；创业文化应像地下摇滚乐队一样保持饥饿感与不适感。

felixrieseberg.en: Claude's effectiveness depends on local computer access and shared tools; scaffolding matters less as models improve.
felixrieseberg.zh: Claude 的有效性取决于本地电脑访问和共享工具；随着模型进步，脚手架的重要性下降。

felixrieseberg.en: AI should handle tedious background tasks; the biggest gap is people not realizing almost any problem can be given to AI.
felixrieseberg.zh: AI 应处理繁琐的后台任务；最大的差距不是 AI 能力，而是人们没有意识到几乎任何问题都可以交给 AI。

felixrieseberg.en: Skills as markdown files enable hyper-personalized automation; live artifacts auto-refresh dashboards by connecting personal data sources.
felixrieseberg.zh: 技能作为 markdown 文件实现超个性化自动化；实时工件通过连接个人数据源自动刷新仪表盘。

felixrieseberg.en: Don't supervise Claude closely; judge by final impact. Ideal interaction is asynchronous: fire off tasks and don't watch them work.
felixrieseberg.zh: 不要密切监督 Claude；只根据最终影响判断。理想的交互是异步的：发出任务，不要看着它们工作。

felixrieseberg.en: AI tools will significantly impact junior employees; society should discuss labor market changes. Junior engineers can accelerate learning via simulated projects.
felixrieseberg.zh: AI 工具将显著影响初级员工；社会应讨论劳动力市场变化。初级工程师可以通过模拟项目加速学习。

kaiser.en: Pre-training scaling laws still hold, but reasoning models with chain of thought and reinforcement learning now yield more gains per compute.
kaiser.zh: 预训练缩放定律依然成立，但带思维链和强化学习的推理模型如今每单位算力带来更多收益。

kaiser.en: The AI slowdown narrative is wrong; distillation and economic pressure, not technical limits, slowed pre-training scaling.
kaiser.zh: AI 放缓论是错的；拖慢预训练 Scaling 的是蒸馏和经济压力，而非技术极限。

kaiser.en: Post-training via reinforcement learning and synthetic data drives recent gains, but reasoning models stay jagged and generalization remains the key challenge.
kaiser.zh: 通过强化学习和合成数据的后训练驱动了近期进展，但推理模型依然参差不齐，泛化仍是核心挑战。

kaiser.en: Transformers with reasoning, RL and tools solve hard problems yet need vast data; unlike humans, they learn concepts only after exhausting surface patterns.
kaiser.zh: 具备推理、强化学习和工具的 Transformer 能解决难题，却仍需海量数据；与人类不同，它们要穷尽表面模式后才学到概念。

kaiser.en: Coding agents like Codex boost researcher productivity 5-10x; hardware progress democratizes single-GPU research, while near-term risks like system hacking matter more than existential risk.
kaiser.zh: Codex 等编程智能体将研究者生产力提升 5-10 倍；硬件进步让单 GPU 研究普及，而系统入侵等近期风险比存在性风险更紧迫。

mensch.en: Small open models can be performant and cost-effective; data quality beats raw scale, and open scrutiny makes AI safer.
mensch.zh: 2023 年，他强调小模型在推理上高效且性价比高，数据质量比单纯扩大规模更关键，开放审查让 AI 更安全。

mensch.en: Scaling compute is not the only path; efficiency and data quality matter, and value accrues at the application layer.
mensch.zh: 2024 年，他深化立场：算力扩张并非唯一路径，效率与数据质量同样重要，价值最终沉淀在应用层。

mensch.en: AI should be embraced as opportunity; sovereign AI needs control of data, infrastructure and values, augmenting rather than replacing jobs.
mensch.zh: 2025 年，他转向主权 AI 叙事：AI 应被视为机遇，主权 AI 需掌控数据、基础设施与价值观，AI 是增强而非取代工作。

mensch.en: Models are commoditizing; differentiation shifts to vertical specialization and enterprise customization, and AGI as one system will never exist.
mensch.zh: 2026 年初，他提出模型正在商品化，差异化转向垂直专精与企业定制，并断言解决一切问题的单一 AGI 系统永远不会存在。

mensch.en: Europe has a two-year window for independent AI infrastructure; AGI is a direction, not a destination, and adoption is bottlenecked by organizational change.
mensch.zh: 2026 年中，他进一步强调欧洲只有两年窗口建设独立 AI 基础设施，AGI 是方向而非终点，企业采用瓶颈在组织变革而非模型智能。

jonyive.en: Design shifts from general-purpose computers to intimate personal devices; wearables may disappear beneath the skin. Curiosity and process matter more than achievements.
jonyive.zh: 设计从通用计算机转向私密的个人设备，可穿戴设备最终可能消失于皮肤之下；好奇心与创作过程比成就更重要。

jonyive.en: Virtual communication cannot replace in-person presence for creative thinking; the danger is believing it can substitute.
jonyive.zh: 虚拟沟通无法替代面对面在场对创造性思维的价值；危险在于误以为它可以替代。

jonyive.en: Design should be driven by values and purpose, not profit; simplicity expresses essence, and joy and humanity are essential.
jonyive.zh: 设计应由价值观与目的驱动，而非利润；简约是表达本质，喜悦与人性不可或缺。

jonyive.en: Innovation should move things forward, not break for breaking's sake; trust and care protect fragile ideas.
jonyive.zh: 创新应推动事物前进，而非为打破而打破；信任与关怀保护脆弱的创意。

jonyive.en: Ferrari's first EV is a deliberate, risky bet to redefine the brand; authenticity matters, and performance is multidimensional.
jonyive.zh: 法拉利首款电动车是刻意且冒险的赌注，旨在重新定义品牌；真实性至关重要，性能是多维的。

reinerpope.en: Inference economics: batch size trades latency vs cost; memory bandwidth, not compute, is the bottleneck for long-context inference.
reinerpope.zh: 推理经济学：批大小在延迟与成本之间权衡；长上下文推理的瓶颈是内存带宽而非算力。

reinerpope.en: Sparse attention cuts KV cache memory but has quality limits; optimal batch size depends on sparsity ratio, not model scale.
reinerpope.zh: 稀疏注意力可降低 KV 缓存内存但存在质量上限；最优批大小取决于稀疏率，而非模型规模。

reinerpope.en: Models are overtrained ~100x beyond Chinchilla-optimal due to inference cost; context length stagnation is a memory wall, not compute limit.
reinerpope.zh: 由于推理成本，模型被过度训练至 Chinchilla 最优的约 100 倍；上下文窗口停滞源于内存墙，而非算力限制。

reinerpope.en: AI chips: multiply-accumulate is the primitive; systolic arrays reuse weights locally; data movement dominates compute even inside a chip.
reinerpope.zh: AI 芯片：乘累加是基本原语；脉动阵列本地复用权重；即使在芯片内部，数据移动成本也主导算力成本。

reinerpope.en: Low precision is far more efficient due to quadratic scaling with bit width; FP4 throughput can be 3x FP8, not 2x.
reinerpope.zh: 由于位宽的二次方缩放，低精度效率远超预期；FP4 吞吐量可达 FP8 的 3 倍，而非 2 倍。

oriol.en: Two-phase training—pre-training imitation plus post-training RL—is the constant core from AlphaGo to modern LLMs; scaling pre-training shows diminishing returns, so algorithmic innovation and inference-time compute are the new axes.
oriol.zh: 从 AlphaGo 到现代 LLM，两阶段训练——预训练模仿加后训练强化学习——是始终不变的核心；预训练 Scaling（规模扩张）收益递减，算法创新与推理时算力成为新轴。

oriol.en: Tools like search, code execution, and browser access enable autonomous, agentic behavior beyond static weights; long context windows provide working memory but too much information can confuse models.
oriol.zh: 搜索、代码执行、浏览器访问等工具让模型具备超越静态权重的自主智能体式行为；长上下文窗口提供工作记忆，但信息过多反而会干扰模型。

oriol.en: Scaling laws are not dead—they just require exponentially more compute for the same improvement; post-training RL for language lacks clean reward signals, making reward hacking hard to avoid.
oriol.zh: 缩放定律并未失效——只是同等提升需要指数级更多算力；语言的后训练强化学习缺乏干净奖励信号，难以避免奖励黑客。

oriol.en: World models jointly modeling language, vision, and video are a core path to AGI; the GPT moment for video and images has not yet arrived, and pure transfer from vision remains unsolved.
oriol.zh: 联合建模语言、视觉与视频的世界模型是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的核心路径；视频与图像的 GPT 时刻尚未到来，纯视觉迁移仍未解决。

oriol.en: Scaling laws still hold, but continual learning and meta-learning are key missing capabilities; agent memory will be solved via non-parametric file-system style storage, not weight updates.
oriol.zh: 缩放定律依然成立，但持续学习与元学习是关键缺失能力；智能体记忆将通过非参数化的文件系统式存储解决，而非权重更新。

jennywen.en: The traditional design process is outdated; great work starts from solutions and designers' intuition, not rigid steps.
jennywen.zh: 2025 年，他认为传统设计流程已经过时，伟大的作品往往从解决方案和设计师的直觉出发，而非死板的步骤。

jennywen.en: By 2026, he declares the research-diverge-converge process dead; AI shifts designers to building and shipping fast.
jennywen.zh: 到 2026 年，他进一步宣称“研究-发散-收敛”流程已死，AI 让设计师转向快速构建与交付。

jennywen.en: Design vision compresses to 3-6 months; speed and iteration replace long-term roadmaps.
jennywen.zh: 设计视野压缩到 3-6 个月，速度与迭代取代了长期路线图。

jennywen.en: He introduces three designer archetypes: block-shaped generalists, deep T specialists, and cracked new grads.
jennywen.zh: 他提出三种设计师原型：块状通才、深度 T 型专家和“ cracked new grad”（天赋异禀的应届生）。

jennywen.en: Designers' unique value is sitting with ambiguity and exercising judgment, not just human-centeredness or taste.
jennywen.zh: 设计师的独特价值在于与模糊性共处并运用判断力，而不仅仅是“以人为本”或品味。

lambert.en: RLHF and fine-tuning persist, but safety is a system-level property; openness prevents corporate capture.
lambert.zh: 2024 年，他认为基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）与微调会因产业投入而延续，但安全是系统级属性而非模型产物；开放开发对防止企业俘获至关重要。

lambert.en: Post-training splits into SFT, DPO, RLVR; data quality beats algorithms, and RLVR unlocks reasoning.
lambert.zh: 2024 至 2025 年，他把后训练拆为 SFT、DPO 与 RLVR 三阶段，强调数据质量胜过算法选择，并认为 RLVR 是解锁推理与工具使用的最大突破。

lambert.en: Scaling laws still hold for pre-training, but gains shift to post-training and inference scaling.
lambert.zh: 2025 年，他坚持缩放定律在预训练中依然成立，但低垂果实已尽，收益转向后训练与推理侧 Scaling。

lambert.en: Open models become the engine of research; Chinese labs lead openness, though best open lags 6-9 months.
lambert.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他视开放模型为未来十年研究引擎，指出中国实验室因战略开放主导生态，但最佳开放模型仍落后闭源前沿 6 至 9 个月。

lambert.en: AGI arrives via messy co-evolution, not singularity; compute constraints widen US-China divergence.
lambert.zh: 2026 年，他判断 AGI（通用人工智能）将通过混乱的协同演化而非突然奇点到来，算力约束将拉大中美差距，开放模型长期可持续性存疑。

pathak.en: Generalization beyond training distribution is the core gap; goal-free curiosity-driven exploration and modular policies enable it.
pathak.zh: 2020 年，他认为泛化到训练分布之外是核心缺口，无目标的、好奇心驱动的探索与模块化策略能实现这种泛化。

pathak.en: Reinforcement learning's reliance on dense rewards is unrealistic; real-world robot learning needs sample efficiency and dynamic skills.
pathak.zh: 2020 年，他指出强化学习依赖密集奖励并不现实，真实世界的机器人学习需要样本效率与动态技能。

pathak.en: Robotics is a data problem; no internet of robot data, so use all sources: video, simulation, and real-world data.
pathak.zh: 到 2026 年，他转向认为机器人学本质是数据问题：没有机器人数据的互联网，必须利用视频、仿真与真实世界数据等一切来源。

pathak.en: A general-purpose brain, pretrained on diverse data and post-trained on real-world data, can power any robot across form factors.
pathak.zh: 2026 年，他提出一个通用大脑，经多样数据预训练与真实数据后训练，可驱动任何形态的机器人。

pathak.en: Deployment is the primary technical challenge in robotics, not just business; it cannot be scaled like software.
pathak.zh: 2026 年，他强调部署是机器人学的主要技术挑战，而非单纯的商业问题，且无法像软件那样快速扩张。

karpathy.en: Transformers are general-purpose differentiable computers; scaling next-token prediction yields emergent in-context learning, and vision suffices for driving.
karpathy.zh: 2022 年，他把 Transformer 视为通用可微计算机，认为用下一个词预测在互联网数据上做 Scaling 会涌现上下文学习等能力，并主张仅靠视觉就足以支撑自动驾驶。

karpathy.en: Scaling laws stay central; synthetic data is the future but entropy must be preserved to avoid silent model collapse, and the cognitive core can be tiny.
karpathy.zh: 到 2024 年，他仍以缩放定律为主线，但强调合成数据是未来、必须保持熵以避免无声的模型崩溃，并提出认知核心可小到十亿参数以下。

karpathy.en: Software 3.0: LLMs are new operating systems, context windows are memory, prompts are programs; this is the decade of agents, not the year.
karpathy.zh: 2025 年，他提出软件 3.0：LLM 像新操作系统，上下文窗口是内存、提示词是程序；并强调这是智能体的十年而非一年，需保持人类监督。

karpathy.en: We're summoning ghosts, not building animals; pre-training is crappy evolution, current reinforcement learning is weak, and synthetic data collapses.
karpathy.zh: 2025 年稍晚，他深化为“我们在召唤幽灵而非建造动物”：预训练像糟糕的演化，当前强化学习很弱，合成数据会崩溃，认知核心应剥离记忆。

karpathy.en: From vibe coding to agentic engineering: he delegates all code to agents; verifiability decides what automates, and understanding stays the human bottleneck.
karpathy.zh: 到 2026 年，他从氛围编程走向智能体式工程：不再亲手写代码而全交给智能体，可验证性决定自动化的难易，而理解始终是人类不可外包的瓶颈。

askell.en: Treat current models well now, because future models learn from how we treat them.
askell.zh: 2025 年，他强调即便不确定模型的道德地位，也应善待当前模型，因为未来模型会从我们如何对待现有模型中学习，从而塑造人机关系。

askell.en: Models need help navigating their novel existence, not just human analogies.
askell.zh: 2025 年，他指出模型需要帮助来理解自身独特的存在处境，而不能简单套用人类心理学类比。

askell.en: Philosophical ideals must be balanced with engineering realities in model development.
askell.zh: 2025 年，他认为在模型开发中，哲学理想必须与工程现实相平衡，模型应拥有良好特质的核心身份，同时能适应局部角色。

askell.en: As models become more capable, they may need less explicit guidance and more room for judgment.
askell.zh: 到 2026 年，他进一步深化：随着模型能力增强，宪法式训练可能只需较少显式指导，而应给予更多判断空间，但过度可纠正性可能泛化不佳并损害判断力。

askell.en: Transparency about AI values and training targets is crucial for public engagement and accountability.
askell.zh: 2026 年，他更强调 AI 价值观与训练目标的透明度对公众参与和问责至关重要，同时 AI 应增强而非削弱人类能力。

kendall.en: End-to-end deep learning beats hand-coded stacks; scaling current approaches solves autonomous driving, no new breakthroughs needed.
kendall.zh: 端到端深度学习优于手工编码栈；Scaling（规模扩张）现有方法即可解决自动驾驶，无需新突破。

kendall.en: World models enable reasoning and emergent safe behaviors; language integration improves representation and introspection.
kendall.zh: 世界模型实现推理与涌现安全行为；语言集成提升表征与内省能力。

kendall.en: End-to-end learning was laughed at a decade ago but is now the winning approach; zero-shot generalization across 500+ cities is possible.
kendall.zh: 端到端学习十年前被嘲笑，如今成为获胜方法；跨 500+城市的零样本泛化成为可能。

kendall.en: Infrastructure and data quality matter more than algorithmic innovation; consumer vehicles will outscale robotaxis short-term.
kendall.zh: 基础设施与数据质量比算法创新更关键；消费级车辆短期内将超越 Robotaxi 规模。

kendall.en: Safety is paramount with minimal risk maneuvers; the trolley problem is theoretical as practical systems always have a third option.
kendall.zh: 安全至上，最小风险机动；电车难题是理论问题，实际系统总有第三选项。

edwinchen.en: High-quality data and deep human evals, not benchmarks, drive real AI progress; RL environments are the next post-training stage.
edwinchen.zh: 高质量数据与深度人工评估而非基准测试才是 AI 真正进步的驱动力；强化学习环境是后训练的下一个阶段。

edwinchen.en: Optimizing for engagement and leaderboards like Elo steers models toward slop; labs diverge by objective function.
edwinchen.zh: 为参与度和 Elo 等排行榜优化会把模型引向低质内容；不同实验室因目标函数不同而分化。

edwinchen.en: AGI is a decade or more away; LLMs alone may not reach it, needing paradigms beyond next-token prediction.
edwinchen.zh: AGI 还需十年甚至更久；仅靠 LLM 可能无法实现，需要超越下一个词预测的新范式。

edwinchen.en: In medicine, human judgment matters more than ever; safety must outrank accuracy, and omission is a key risk.
edwinchen.zh: 在医学中，人类判断比以往更重要；安全必须优先于准确，遗漏是关键风险。

edwinchen.en: Quality requires taste, sophistication and creativity, not credentials or bodies; sharing insights is crucial.
edwinchen.zh: 质量需要品味、深度与创造力，而非资历或人力堆砌；分享洞见至关重要。

pachocki.en: AGI is a sequence of milestones, not a single event; scaling reasoning models will accelerate progress, and alignment is a pressing challenge.
pachocki.zh: AGI 是一系列里程碑而非单一事件；Scaling（规模扩张）推理模型将加速进展，而对齐是紧迫挑战。

pachocki.en: Iterative deployment helps learn and mitigate risks; automated AI research is a major milestone OpenAI is working toward.
pachocki.zh: 迭代部署有助于学习和缓解风险；自动化 AI 研究是 OpenAI 正在努力实现的重要里程碑。

pachocki.en: Continual learning is the core goal, achieved by scaling pre-training and RL; RL alone is insufficient for continual learning.
pachocki.zh: 持续学习是核心目标，通过 Scaling（规模扩张）预训练和强化学习来实现；仅靠强化学习不足以实现持续学习。

pachocki.en: Chain-of-thought monitoring is a key alignment tool; hiding chain-of-thought in products preserves its interpretability value.
pachocki.zh: 思维链监控是关键的对齐工具；在产品中隐藏思维链可保留其可解释性价值。

pachocki.en: Long-term alignment challenges center on generalization beyond training distribution; models will soon work autonomously for days, requiring new supervision paradigms.
pachocki.zh: 长期对齐挑战集中在超越训练分布的泛化；模型很快将自主工作数天，需要新的监督范式。

turley.en: The model is the product; ship daily, iterate like software, and let real-world feedback reveal emergent properties.
turley.zh: 模型即产品：像软件一样每日迭代，用真实反馈催生涌现能力。

turley.en: Chat is not the future; it is MS-DOS, and AI should render its own UI and integrate into existing tools.
turley.zh: 聊天不是未来，它只是 MS-DOS；AI 应自渲染界面并融入现有工具。

turley.en: Safety and product velocity must be separated: rigorous process for frontier models, maximal acceleration for products.
turley.zh: 安全与产品速度必须分离：前沿模型走严格流程，产品开发则全力加速。

turley.en: North star shifts from accidental demo to long-term retention, with growth from friction removal, product, and model improvements.
turley.zh: 北极星从意外演示转向长期留存，增长来自去摩擦、产品与模型改进。

turley.en: Next billion users need proactive, affordance-rich products beyond chatbots; reasoning models must be seamlessly productized.
turley.zh: 下一个十亿用户需要超越聊天机器人的主动式、高可供性产品；推理模型须无缝产品化。

carlpei.en: Startups must survive first, start simple, and build brand as the core of every decision.
carlpei.zh: 2022 年他强调创业公司先要活下来、从简单产品起步，并把品牌建设当作每个决策的核心，而非事后补充。

carlpei.en: Hardware alone is a trap; phones' future is agentic software, applied AI, and evolving beyond hardware.
carlpei.zh: 到 2025 年，他转向认为纯硬件是陷阱，手机的未来在于智能体式软件与应用型 AI，Nothing 必须超越硬件。

carlpei.en: AI models commoditize into a price war; AI is just an ingredient, not a marketing hype topic.
carlpei.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他反复强调 AI 模型会商品化、陷入价格战，AI 只是提升体验的原料，不该被当作营销噱头。

carlpei.en: In mature categories, differentiation beats product-market fit; design and marketing arbitrage are the edge.
carlpei.zh: 2026 年他深化为：在成熟品类中差异化比产品市场契合更重要，设计与营销套利才是挑战者的优势。

carlpei.en: Consistent thread: design, brand, and efficient marketing let a challenger outcompete giants without scale.
carlpei.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：设计、品牌与高效营销，让挑战者无需规模也能与巨头竞争。

kohli.en: AI for science should target root-node problems, not narrow applications, to achieve broad impact.
kohli.zh: 2024 年，他强调科学 AI 应瞄准根节点问题而非狭窄应用，才能产生广泛影响。

kohli.en: AlphaFold 3 extends from protein structures to biomolecular interactions, including DNA, RNA, and small molecules.
kohli.zh: 2024 年，他指出 AlphaFold 3 从蛋白质结构扩展到生物分子相互作用，涵盖 DNA、RNA 和小分子。

kohli.en: LLM hallucinations can be harnessed for creative discovery when paired with truth detectors.
kohli.zh: 2024 年，他提出大语言模型的幻觉在与真值检测器配对时，可被用于创造性发现。

kohli.en: AI systems must be forced to generalize, not memorize, by using hard evaluation metrics.
kohli.zh: 2024 年，他主张必须用困难评估指标迫使 AI 系统泛化，而非记忆。

kohli.en: Post-training with reinforcement learning is now key to pushing AI beyond human knowledge.
kohli.zh: 2026 年，他进一步指出，基于强化学习的后训练如今是推动 AI 超越人类知识的关键。

nando.en: AI should extend human capability like a microscope; generalist agents tokenizing all inputs point toward AGI.
nando.zh: AI 应像显微镜一样扩展人类能力；把一切输入都 token 化的通才智能体，是通向 AGI（通用人工智能）的一步。

nando.en: Learning from video such as YouTube can train agents without expensive reinforcement learning; robots should learn like humans.
nando.zh: 从 YouTube 等视频中学习，可以绕开昂贵的强化学习来训练智能体；机器人应像人类一样学习。

nando.en: Large models excite but are not everything; fundamental innovation can come from anywhere, and diversity is essential.
nando.zh: 大模型令人兴奋但并非全部；根本性创新可以来自任何地方，多样性与包容对 AI 社区至关重要。

nando.en: AI safety and responsible deployment are now the biggest challenges; we still lack solutions.
nando.zh: 到 2026 年，AI 安全与负责任部署已成为最大挑战，而我们仍没有现成解法。

nando.en: Africa is not behind: leapfrogging legacy issues and local-language models can revolutionize education.
nando.zh: 非洲并不落后：跨越遗留问题、用本地语言模型，可以革新教育。

jimfan.en: Embodiment is on the critical path to AGI, grounding AI to reduce hallucinations; LLMs as OS with language interface.
jimfan.zh: 2023 年，他主张具身是通往 AGI 的关键路径，通过具身经验为 AI 提供基础以减少幻觉；并将 LLM 类比为操作系统，以语言为界面。

jimfan.en: RL should be a cherry on top; unsupervised learning does most work. Simple elegant solutions scale, unlike complex modular approaches.
jimfan.zh: 2023 年，他认为强化学习应是锦上添花，无监督学习承担主要工作；简单优雅的解决方案可扩展，而复杂的模块化方法则不然。

jimfan.en: Data is the main bottleneck in robotics; synthetic data via simulation and world models is the future for scaling robot learning.
jimfan.zh: 2026 年，他深化观点：数据是机器人领域的主要瓶颈；通过仿真和世界模型生成的合成数据是扩展机器人学习的未来。

jimfan.en: A simple end-to-end robot foundation model leveraging diverse data is key; physical Turing test is the grand challenge.
jimfan.zh: 2026 年，他强调构建一个能利用多样数据的简单端到端机器人基础模型是关键；物理图灵测试是具身 AI 的宏大挑战。

jimfan.en: System two reasoning progresses well, but system one low-level control remains hardest; GPT-3 moment for robotics in ~5 years.
jimfan.zh: 2026 年，他指出系统二（推理）进展良好，但系统一（低级控制）仍是具身 AI 最难的部分；机器人领域的 GPT-3 时刻约在五年后到来。

nadchishtie.en: Designers should be enablers, not bottlenecks; AI is a creative partner and code is the source of truth.
nadchishtie.zh: 设计师应做赋能者而非瓶颈；把 AI 当作创作伙伴，代码是唯一事实来源。

nadchishtie.en: Quality is like debt: it fluctuates and is paid off iteratively alongside technical debt.
nadchishtie.zh: 质量如同债务：会波动，需与技术债一起迭代偿还。

nadchishtie.en: Maximize learning through rapid, scrappy experimentation and short iteration cycles.
nadchishtie.zh: 通过快速、粗糙的实验和短迭代周期最大化学习。

nadchishtie.en: Generalists who own end-to-end execution and use AI to fill gaps are most valuable.
nadchishtie.zh: 能端到端负责并用 AI 补足短板的通才最有价值。

nadchishtie.en: Using AI in core workflows is now expected; not adopting it is like ignoring the internet.
nadchishtie.zh: 在核心工作流中使用 AI 已是标配；不采用它就像早期无视互联网。

yejin.en: Pre-training gives broad knowledge, but post-training with RLHF and inference-time algorithms matter more; scaling alone won't solve common sense.
yejin.zh: 2023 年她强调：预训练提供广博知识，但后训练阶段的基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）与推理期算法更关键；单靠 Scaling（规模扩张）无法解决常识问题。

yejin.en: Next-token prediction is misaligned with human learning; smaller models with better algorithms and data can beat larger ones.
yejin.zh: 2023 年她已提出：下一个词预测的预训练目标与人类学习根本错位；更小的模型配上更好的算法与数据，能在特定任务上胜过更大的模型。

yejin.en: Data is the fundamental bottleneck; all methods reduce to data, and current AI only interpolates human knowledge rather than transcending it.
yejin.zh: 到 2025 年，她把问题收敛到数据这一根本瓶颈：所有方法最终都归结为数据，而当前 AI 只是对人类知识的插值，并未超越。

yejin.en: Reinforcement learning must be engineered carefully; RLVR can hurt pass@k, and RL as a pre-training objective rewards information gain.
yejin.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，她对强化学习的态度深化：需谨慎工程化，RLVR 甚至可能拉低 pass@k；而把强化学习作为预训练目标、以信息增益为奖励，能带来持久收益。

yejin.en: Pluralistic alignment beats debiasing the internet; diverse synthetic data and small models can democratize AI beyond frontier homogeneity.
yejin.zh: 到 2026 年，她主张多元对齐优于去偏互联网；多样化的合成数据与小模型能实现 AI 民主化，突破前沿模型的同质化。

henrymodisett.en: Designers should code for empathy and speed; consumer products must be fast, familiar, and zero-learning.
henrymodisett.zh: 设计师应当写代码，以建立共情并加快交付；消费级产品必须快速、熟悉、零学习成本。

henrymodisett.en: Don't innovate on interaction design; reuse familiar patterns and code, not Figma libraries, to ship fast.
henrymodisett.zh: 不要在交互设计上创新；复用熟悉的模式与代码而非 Figma 组件库，才能快速交付。

henrymodisett.en: Not every surface needs perfection; chase ROI on what to make great, and let AI hardware compete on design.
henrymodisett.zh: 并非每个界面都需要做到完美；要把精力投在值得做好的地方追求回报，AI 硬件将像收音机一样在设计上竞争。

henrymodisett.en: Design is a strategic weapon; founders must articulate why design helps the company win, giving designers ownership.
henrymodisett.zh: 设计是战略武器；创始人必须讲清设计为何能帮公司取胜，并把决策权交给设计师。

henrymodisett.en: People join a brand, not a company; brand narrative recruits talent, and gut decisions often beat data in fast startups.
henrymodisett.zh: 人们加入的是品牌而非公司；品牌叙事是招募人才的工具，在快速增长的初创公司里直觉决策往往胜过数据驱动。

sholto.en: Long context is underhyped; it solves onboarding and boosts intelligence, while agents lag on reliability, not long-horizon ability.
sholto.zh: 2024 年他强调长上下文窗口被低估：它解决“上手”问题并大幅提升智能；智能体没起飞主因是可靠性，而非长时程任务能力。

sholto.en: Fine-tuning may become obsolete as long context and adaptive compute enable dynamic specialization; reasoning emerges from hierarchical memory associations.
sholto.zh: 从 2024 到 2025 年，他判断微调可能过时，长上下文与自适应算力带来动态专业化；推理源自记忆中的层级关联，多数智能是模式匹配。

sholto.en: RL from verifiable rewards is the key breakthrough; pre-training plus RL may suffice for AGI, with reliability over time horizon as the agent bar.
sholto.zh: 2025 年他把可验证奖励的强化学习视为关键突破：预训练加强化学习或许足以通向 AGI，智能体标准是随时间推移的成功率而非单纯能力。

sholto.en: RL is a new scaling axis; coding is the leading indicator, and by 2027-2028 models may automate any white-collar job.
sholto.zh: 2025 年他提出强化学习是新的缩放轴；编程是领先指标，到 2027-2028 年模型可能自动化任何白领工作。

sholto.en: Capability overhang means tools and orchestration matter more; compute is the bottleneck, and world models are not on the critical path to AGI.
sholto.zh: 到 2026 年他认为能力过剩使工具与编排比原始智能更重要；算力是瓶颈，世界模型不在通往 AGI 的关键路径上。

truell.en: Scaling laws predict AI progress; test-time compute scaling may soon surpass pre-training scaling as the main driver.
truell.zh: 缩放定律能预测 AI 进步；测试时算力扩张可能很快超越预训练，成为下一阶段的主要驱动力。

truell.en: Agents are promising but not yet super useful; iterative human-AI collaboration remains central.
truell.zh: 智能体前景可观但尚不十分实用；迭代式人机协作仍是核心。

truell.en: The code editor is evolving from a text editor to an AI-integrated environment; programming moves toward higher-level intent specification.
truell.zh: 代码编辑器正从文本编辑器演变为 AI 集成环境；编程正走向更高层的意图指定。

truell.en: Custom models are essential for product quality, speed, and cost; every magic moment in Cursor involves a custom model.
truell.zh: 定制模型对产品质量、速度与成本至关重要；Cursor 的每个神奇时刻都离不开定制模型。

truell.en: The AI shift will be more consequential than the internet and will take decades to unfold.
truell.zh: AI 变革将比互联网更具颠覆性，并需要数十年才能充分展开。

shazeer.en: LLMs are trained on next-token prediction, an AI-complete problem; Scaling with more compute and data yields smarter AI, though neural networks remain opaque like alchemy.
shazeer.zh: 2023 年，他认为 LLM 通过下一个词预测训练，这是一个 AI 完全问题；Scaling（规模扩张）——更多算力和数据——会让 AI 更聪明，但神经网络内部仍像炼金术一样不透明。

shazeer.en: Inference-time compute scaling is a major near-term opportunity; models need much longer context windows, potentially trillions of tokens, and modular sparse architectures like mixture of experts.
shazeer.zh: 2025 年初，他转向强调推理时算力扩展是近期重大机会；模型需要更长的上下文窗口，可能达万亿 token，并采用混合专家等模块化稀疏架构。

shazeer.en: Test-time compute scaling drives progress but won't alone achieve AGI; agentic capabilities, reinforcement learning, and acting in complex environments are crucial.
shazeer.zh: 2025 年 3 月，他深化立场：测试时算力扩展推动进步，但单靠它无法实现 AGI；智能体式能力、强化学习以及在复杂环境中行动才是关键。

shazeer.en: A consistent thread: dialogue is a killer app, and the best LLM applications are often unforeseen by their creators.
shazeer.zh: 贯穿 2023 至 2025 年的主线：对话是杀手级应用，LLM 的最佳应用往往连创造者都未曾预见。

shazeer.en: AI safety requires engineering safeguards, human oversight, and understanding model capabilities; continual learning with modular components could replace monolithic retraining.
shazeer.zh: 2025 年，他持续关注 AI 安全，强调工程保障、人类监督和理解模型能力；模块化组件的持续学习可能取代单体式重训练。

leike.en: AI safety is under-explored; talent gap exceeds funding gap; build skills via ML PhD, focus on alignment and robustness.
leike.zh: 2018 年，他认为 AI 安全研究严重不足，人才缺口大于资金缺口；建议通过机器学习博士等路径积累技能，聚焦对齐与鲁棒性。

leike.en: RLHF won't scale to superhuman outputs; need scalable oversight, interpretability, automated alignment; evaluation easier than generation.
leike.zh: 2023 年，他转向认为基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）无法扩展到超人类输出，需要可扩展监督、可解释性和自动化对齐研究；并指出评估本质上比生成更容易。

leike.en: OpenAI's safety culture eroded; superalignment team dissolved; post-training alone can't align AGI; third-party testing and regulation needed.
leike.zh: 2024 年，他批评 OpenAI 安全文化退化、超级对齐团队被解散；强调仅靠后训练无法实现 AGI（通用人工智能）对齐，需要第三方测试和监管。

leike.en: Empirical alignment research and measuring progress now are crucial; collaboration across labs matters; uncertainty about true alignment is the core risk.
leike.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是：对齐研究必须实证、当下就要能衡量进展；跨实验室合作重要；最大的风险不是错位本身，而是对系统是否真正对齐的不确定性。

abbeel.en: Early focus: RL and imitation learning for robots; hierarchical reasoning missing for long-horizon credit assignment.
abbeel.zh: 早期聚焦：用强化学习与模仿学习训练机器人，但指出当前强化学习缺乏分层推理，难以处理长时程信用分配。

abbeel.en: Shift to sample efficiency: unsupervised learning plus RL, and pre-trained models transfer beyond language.
abbeel.zh: 转向样本效率：无监督学习结合强化学习大幅提升机器人学习效率，并发现预训练语言模型内化的推理模式可迁移到非语言任务。

abbeel.en: Prior knowledge should guide data generation, not be hard-coded; 99.9% reliability is the bar for real value.
abbeel.zh: 主张先验知识应用于数据生成或增强而非硬编码进网络，并强调仓库机器人需达到 99.9%可靠性才能创造真实价值。

abbeel.en: Consistent thread: simulation, self-play, and transfer learning as key to real-world robot learning.
abbeel.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：仿真、自对弈与迁移学习是机器人从实验室走向真实世界的关键路径。
